entries.citation: WISA — "WISA: World Simulator Assistant for Physics-Aware Text-to-Video Generation." arXiv 2503.08153 (2025).

entries.name: LLMPhy
entries.fullTitle: LLMPhy: Parameter-Identifiable Physical Reasoning Combining Large Language Models and Physics Engines
entries.description: Uses language-generated simulation programs and iterative feedback to identify scene parameters and construct physical digital twins.
entries.citation: LLMPhy — "LLMPhy: Parameter-Identifiable Physical Reasoning Combining Large Language Models and Physics Engines." arXiv 2411.08027 (2024).

entries.name: Transformers and Slot Encoding for Sample Efficient Physical World Modelling
entries.fullTitle: Transformers and Slot Encoding for Sample Efficient Physical World Modelling
entries.description: Combines slot-attention object representations with transformer dynamics for sample-efficient physical prediction.
entries.citation: Transformers and Slot Encoding for Sample Efficient Physical World Modelling — arXiv 2405.20180 (2024).

entries.name: A Compositional Object-Based Approach to Learning Physical Dynamics
entries.fullTitle: A Compositional Object-Based Approach to Learning Physical Dynamics
entries.description: Learns object-based physical simulators by composing pairwise interactions, supporting motion prediction and transfer across object counts.
entries.citation: A Compositional Object-Based Approach to Learning Physical Dynamics — arXiv 1612.00341 (2016).

entries.name: DPI-Net
entries.fullTitle: Learning Particle Dynamics for Manipulating Rigid Bodies, Deformable Objects, and Fluids
entries.description: Graph neural network world model for particle-based physics simulation.
entries.citation: DPI-Net — Li, Y. et al. "Learning Particle Dynamics for Manipulating Rigid Bodies, Deformable Objects, and Fluids." ICLR 2019.

entries.name: FIGNet
entries.fullTitle: Learning rigid dynamics with face interaction graph networks
entries.description: Models rigid-body collisions through interactions between mesh faces and learns frictional dynamics for physical simulation and planning.
entries.citation: FIGNet — "Learning rigid dynamics with face interaction graph networks." ICLR 2023.

entries.name: Physics Cognition in Video Generation
entries.fullTitle: Exploring the Evolution of Physics Cognition in Video Generation: A Survey
entries.citation: Physics Cognition in Video Generation — "Exploring the Evolution of Physics Cognition in Video Generation: A Survey." arXiv 2503.21765 (2025).

entries.name: PhyWorld
entries.fullTitle: How Far is Video Generation from World Model: A Physical Law Perspective
entries.description: A physically grounded diagnostic that asks whether video generators obey the laws needed for usable world simulation.
entries.citation: PhyWorld — "How Far is Video Generation from World Model: A Physical Law Perspective." arXiv 2411.02385 (2024).

entries.name: Physically Native World Models
entries.fullTitle: Physically Native World Models: A Hamiltonian Perspective on Generative World Modeling
entries.description: Frames physically grounded world modeling through Hamiltonian-inspired latent dynamics, control, and dissipation.
entries.citation: Physically Native World Models — "Physically Native World Models: A Hamiltonian Perspective on Generative World Modeling." arXiv 2605.00412 (2026).

entries.name: LaWM
entries.fullTitle: LaWM: Least Action World Models for Long-Horizon Physical Consistency from Visual Observations
entries.description: Uses a latent variational integrator so long-horizon rollouts are induced by a learned least-action principle.
entries.citation: LaWM — "LaWM: Least Action World Models for Long-Horizon Physical Consistency from Visual Observations." arXiv 2605.08279 (2026).

entries.name: ACWM-Phys
entries.fullTitle: ACWM-Phys: Investigating Generalized Physical Interaction in Action-Conditioned Video World Models
entries.description: Probes whether action-conditioned video world models capture generalized physical interactions beyond visual interpolation.
entries.citation: ACWM-Phys — "ACWM-Phys: Investigating Generalized Physical Interaction in Action-Conditioned Video World Models." arXiv 2605.08567 (2026).

entries.name: Physically Viable World Models
entries.fullTitle: Physically Viable World Models: A Case for Query-Conditioned Embodied AI
entries.description: Argues for query-conditioned physical abstractions that preserve intervention-relevant structure for planning, control, and verification.
entries.citation: Physically Viable World Models — "Physically Viable World Models: A Case for Query-Conditioned Embodied AI." arXiv 2605.30542 (2026).

entries.name: OptiWorld
entries.fullTitle: OptiWorld: Optimal Control for Video World Generation under Physical Constraints
entries.description: Introduces optimal-control guidance for video world generation so generated dynamics satisfy smoother, safer, and more physically plausible constraints.
entries.citation: OptiWorld — "OptiWorld: Optimal Control for Video World Generation under Physical Constraints." arXiv 2606.00499 (2026).

entries.name: Physical Object Understanding
entries.fullTitle: Physical Object Understanding with a Physically Controllable World Model
entries.description: Learns object-level physical structure from video and exposes controllable interactions, a useful bridge between visual prediction and physical reasoning.
entries.citation: Physical Object Understanding — "Physical Object Understanding with a Physically Controllable World Model." CVPR 2026 Highlight.

entries.name: MeGAS
entries.fullTitle: MeGAS: Thermomechanical Dynamic Gaussian Splatting for Thermophysical Scene Editing
entries.description: Adds temperature-aware MPM dynamics and thermomechanical phase changes to dynamic Gaussian splatting, strengthening the physics side of editable visual world models.
entries.citation: MeGAS — "MeGAS: Thermomechanical Dynamic Gaussian Splatting for Thermophysical Scene Editing." ECCV 2026.

entries.name: PhysiFormer
entries.fullTitle: PhysiFormer: Learning to Simulate Mechanics in World Space
entries.description: Diffusion-transformer mechanics simulator that predicts probabilistic future 3D mesh trajectories directly in world coordinates for rigid and elastic objects.
entries.citation: PhysiFormer — "PhysiFormer: Learning to Simulate Mechanics in World Space." arXiv 2606.27364 (2026).

entries.name: LithoDreamer
entries.fullTitle: LithoDreamer: A Physics-Informed World Model for Multi-Stage Computational Lithography
entries.description: Models lithography as a multi-stage physical state-evolution process, pairing forward prediction with intervention optimization for inverse planning.
entries.citation: LithoDreamer — "LithoDreamer: A Physics-Informed World Model for Multi-Stage Computational Lithography." arXiv 2606.26713 (2026).

entries.name: Interaction Networks
entries.fullTitle: Interaction Networks for Learning about Objects, Relations and Physics
entries.description: Foundational learned physics simulator: object- and relation-centric dynamics model that rolls out n-body, rigid-collision, and non-rigid systems.
entries.citation: Interaction Networks — Battaglia, P. et al. "Interaction Networks for Learning about Objects, Relations and Physics." NeurIPS 2016.

entries.name: IntPhys
entries.fullTitle: IntPhys: A Framework and Benchmark for Visual Intuitive Physics Reasoning
entries.description: Violation-of-expectation benchmark (object permanence, shape constancy, spatio-temporal continuity) for evaluating intuitive physics in predictive models.
entries.citation: IntPhys — Riochet, R. et al. "IntPhys: A Framework and Benchmark for Visual Intuitive Physics Reasoning." TPAMI 2021.

entries.name: PHYRE
entries.fullTitle: PHYRE: A New Benchmark for Physical Reasoning
entries.description: 2D physics-puzzle benchmark where agents act by intervention (placing objects) and must predict resulting dynamics; a standard testbed for physical world models.
entries.citation: PHYRE — Bakhtin, A. et al. "PHYRE: A New Benchmark for Physical Reasoning." NeurIPS 2019.

entries.name: CoPhy
entries.fullTitle: CoPhy: Counterfactual Learning of Physical Dynamics
entries.description: Counterfactual physical dynamics benchmark and model: predict outcomes after a do-intervention modifies the initial scene.
entries.citation: CoPhy — Baradel, F. et al. "CoPhy: Counterfactual Learning of Physical Dynamics." ICLR 2020.

entries.name: CLEVRER
entries.fullTitle: CLEVRER: Collision Events for Video Representation and Reasoning
entries.description: Diagnostic video benchmark for descriptive, explanatory, predictive, and counterfactual reasoning about collision dynamics.
entries.citation: CLEVRER — Yi, K. et al. "CLEVRER: Collision Events for Video Representation and Reasoning." ICLR 2020.

entries.name: GNS
entries.fullTitle: Learning to Simulate Complex Physics with Graph Networks
entries.description: Graph network simulator for fluids, rigid solids, and deformables; the standard particle-based learned physics simulator that FIGNet (already listed) builds on.
entries.citation: GNS — Sanchez-Gonzalez, A. et al. "Learning to Simulate Complex Physics with Graph Networks." ICML 2020.

entries.name: Physion
entries.fullTitle: Physion: Evaluating Physical Prediction from Vision in Humans and Machines
entries.description: Human-calibrated benchmark of visual physical prediction across eight scenario types (support, collide, contain, drape, etc.).
entries.citation: Physion — Bear, D. M. et al. "Physion: Evaluating Physical Prediction from Vision in Humans and Machines." NeurIPS 2021 D&B.

entries.name: PhysGaussian
entries.fullTitle: PhysGaussian: Physics-Integrated 3D Gaussians for Generative Dynamics
entries.description: Embeds continuum-mechanics (MPM) dynamics directly into 3D Gaussian scene representations, unifying simulation and rendering ("what you see is what you simulate").
entries.citation: PhysGaussian — "PhysGaussian: Physics-Integrated 3D Gaussians for Generative Dynamics." CVPR 2024.

entries.name: PhysDreamer
entries.fullTitle: PhysDreamer: Physics-Based Interaction with 3D Objects via Video Generation
entries.description: Distills material properties from video-generation priors into 3D objects so static assets respond realistically to novel interaction forces.
entries.citation: PhysDreamer — "PhysDreamer: Physics-Based Interaction with 3D Objects via Video Generation." ECCV 2024.

entries.name: PhysGen (ECCV 2024)
entries.fullTitle: PhysGen: Rigid-Body Physics-Grounded Image-to-Video Generation
entries.description: Simulation-in-the-loop image-to-video: rigid-body simulation of inferred scene physics drives generative rendering under user-specified forces. Distinct from the 2026 PhysGen (2603.00110) already listed.
entries.citation: PhysGen (ECCV 2024) — "PhysGen: Rigid-Body Physics-Grounded Image-to-Video Generation." ECCV 2024.

entries.name: Physics-IQ
entries.fullTitle: Do generative video models understand physical principles?
entries.description: Original Physics-IQ benchmark (real-video physical understanding across solids, fluids, optics, thermodynamics, magnetism); shows visual realism does not imply physics understanding. The already-listed "Physics-IQ Verified" (2606.18943) is its audited follow-up.
entries.citation: Physics-IQ — Motamed, S. et al. "Do generative video models understand physical principles?" arXiv 2501.09038 (2025).

entries.name: ThermoForce
entries.fullTitle: ThermoForce: A Physics-Structured Interventional World Model for Building HVAC Control
entries.description: Separates passive forecasting from causal response to control interventions with a physics-structured thermal world model; a clean case study in intervention-valid world modeling.
entries.citation: ThermoForce — "ThermoForce: A Physics-Structured Interventional World Model for Building HVAC Control." arXiv 2607.03942 (2026).

entries.name: Mechanistic World Models
entries.fullTitle: From Observation to Insight: Mechanistic World Models and the Quest for Autonomous Discovery
entries.description: Position paper arguing that scientific discovery requires world models that expose reusable explanatory mechanisms rather than pure predictive accuracy.
entries.citation: Mechanistic World Models — "From Observation to Insight: Mechanistic World Models and the Quest for Autonomous Discovery." arXiv 2607.12474 (2026).

entries.name: POKEWORLD
entries.fullTitle: What Can Latent World Models Know? Physical Parameter Identifiability in Multimodal Predictive Representations
entries.description: Certificate-gated protocol testing which hidden physical parameters (mass, drag, stiffness) actually enter a latent world model's representation.
entries.citation: POKEWORLD — "What Can Latent World Models Know? Physical Parameter Identifiability in Multimodal Predictive Representations." arXiv 2607.27017 (2026).

entries.name: ODEWorld
entries.fullTitle: ODEWorld: A Continuous Predictive Architecture via Physical-Time Flow
entries.description: Learns a continuous latent velocity field in physical time (ODE-parameterized) instead of discrete-step prediction for world modeling of continuous dynamics.
entries.citation: ODEWorld — "ODEWorld: A Continuous Predictive Architecture via Physical-Time Flow." arXiv 2607.27924 (2026).

entries.name: PhiZero
entries.fullTitle: PhiZero: A World Model Built Around Physical Language
entries.description: Learns a compact discrete "physical language" of world-state transitions from in-the-wild video and predicts in that space rather than in pixels.
entries.citation: PhiZero — "PhiZero: A World Model Built Around Physical Language." arXiv 2607.28624 (2026).

entries.name: ClosurePairs
entries.fullTitle: Why Does the Future Branch? Identifiable Closure Tests for Stochastic Physical World Models
entries.description: Proves ordinary transitions cannot distinguish state-aliasing from intrinsic stochasticity in physical world models, and gives an identifiable test that can.
entries.citation: ClosurePairs — "Why Does the Future Branch? Identifiable Closure Tests for Stochastic Physical World Models." arXiv 2608.00591 (2026).

entries.name: HERA
entries.fullTitle: HERA: Historical Evidence Routing Adapter for Physical Prediction in Latent World Models
entries.description: Routes preserved historical evidence back into latent predictions so physical events under occlusion remain predictable when the evidence leaves the current view.
entries.citation: HERA — "HERA: Historical Evidence Routing Adapter for Physical Prediction in Latent World Models." arXiv 2608.05523 (2026).

entries.name: PhyS
entries.fullTitle: Distilling Physical Priors into Streaming World Models
entries.description: Injects physics priors into few-step causal streaming world models, addressing prior loss during bidirectional-to-causal distillation.
entries.citation: PhyS — "Distilling Physical Priors into Streaming World Models." arXiv 2608.07981 (2026).

entries.name: Learned Physical Invariants
entries.fullTitle: Correcting a learned physical invariant improves world-model rollouts
entries.description: Recovers an energy-like conserved quantity inside a frozen DreamerV3 latent and projects rollouts back onto its level set, reducing long-horizon rollout error.
entries.citation: Learned Physical Invariants — "Correcting a learned physical invariant improves world-model rollouts." arXiv 2608.23526 (2026).

entries.name: Earth System World Model
entries.fullTitle: Earth System World Model for What-If Simulations: A Case Study for Terrestrial Ecosystems
entries.description: Learns intervention-conditioned ecosystem transitions through transition-action pretraining and masked response learning, supporting partial state edits and coupled long-horizon ecosystem responses.
entries.citation: Earth System World Model — "Earth System World Model for What-If Simulations: A Case Study for Terrestrial Ecosystems." arXiv 2609.08855 (2026).

entries.name: Pangu-Weather
entries.fullTitle: Accurate medium-range global weather forecasting with 3D neural networks
entries.description: 3D Earth Transformer for medium-range weather forecasting; faster and more accurate than traditional NWP.
entries.citation: Pangu-Weather — Bi, K. et al. "Accurate medium-range global weather forecasting with 3D neural networks." Nature (2023).

entries.name: GraphCast
entries.fullTitle: Learning skillful medium-range global weather forecasting
entries.citation: GraphCast — Lam, R. et al. "Learning skillful medium-range global weather forecasting." Science (2023).

entries.name: EO-WM
entries.fullTitle: EO-WM: A Physically Informed World Model for Probabilistic Earth Observation Forecasting
entries.description: Frames multispectral Earth-observation forecasting as weather-conditioned probabilistic world modeling with explicit physical-stress diagnostics.
entries.citation: EO-WM — "EO-WM: A Physically Informed World Model for Probabilistic Earth Observation Forecasting." arXiv 2606.27277 (2026).

entries.name: FourCastNet
entries.fullTitle: FourCastNet: A Global Data-driven High-resolution Weather Model using Adaptive Fourier Neural Operators
entries.description: First 0.25° global data-driven weather emulator; established that neural surrogates can roll the atmospheric state forward at competitive skill and orders-of-magnitude lower cost.
entries.citation: FourCastNet — Pathak, J. et al. "FourCastNet: A Global Data-driven High-resolution Weather Model using Adaptive Fourier Neural Operators." arXiv 2202.11214 (2022).

entries.name: ClimaX
entries.fullTitle: ClimaX: A foundation model for weather and climate
entries.description: Foundation model pretrained on heterogeneous climate simulations, fine-tunable to forecasting, projection, and downscaling of the earth system.
entries.citation: ClimaX — Nguyen, T. et al. "ClimaX: A foundation model for weather and climate." ICML 2023.

entries.name: NeuralGCM
entries.fullTitle: Neural General Circulation Models for Weather and Climate
entries.description: Differentiable hybrid of a dynamical core with learned physics; a simulator of the atmosphere spanning weather forecasts to multi-decade climate rollouts.
entries.citation: NeuralGCM — Kochkov, D. et al. "Neural General Circulation Models for Weather and Climate." Nature (2024).

entries.name: GenCast
entries.fullTitle: GenCast: Diffusion-based ensemble forecasting for medium-range weather
entries.description: Probabilistic diffusion successor to GraphCast (already listed): generates skillful forecast ensembles of future global atmospheric states.
entries.citation: GenCast — Price, I. et al. "GenCast: Diffusion-based ensemble forecasting for medium-range weather." Nature (2025).

entries.name: ACE
entries.fullTitle: ACE: A fast, skillful learned global atmospheric model for climate prediction
entries.description: Ai2 Climate Emulator: autoregressive neural emulation of a full atmospheric GCM with approximate conservation, stable over multi-year rollouts.
entries.citation: ACE — Watt-Meyer, O. et al. "ACE: A fast, skillful learned global atmospheric model for climate prediction." arXiv 2310.02074 (2023).

entries.name: Aardvark Weather
entries.fullTitle: Aardvark weather: end-to-end data-driven weather forecasting
entries.description: Replaces the entire NWP pipeline — observations to state estimation to forecast — with one end-to-end learned system of the atmosphere.
entries.citation: Aardvark Weather — Vaughan, A. et al. "Aardvark weather: end-to-end data-driven weather forecasting." Nature (2025).

entries.name: Aurora
entries.fullTitle: A Foundation Model for the Earth System
entries.description: Earth-system foundation model pretrained on >1M hours of geophysical data; one rollout backbone fine-tuned to air quality, waves, cyclones, and weather.
entries.citation: Aurora — Bodnar, C. et al. "A Foundation Model for the Earth System." Nature (2025).

entries.name: Spherical DYffusion
entries.fullTitle: Probabilistic Emulation of a Global Climate Model with Spherical DYffusion
entries.description: Dynamics-informed spherical diffusion emulator producing stable, physically consistent decade-scale probabilistic climate ensembles.
entries.citation: Spherical DYffusion — Cachay, S. R. et al. "Probabilistic Emulation of a Global Climate Model with Spherical DYffusion." NeurIPS 2024.

entries.name: Prithvi WxC
entries.fullTitle: Prithvi WxC: Foundation Model for Weather and Climate
entries.description: NASA/IBM open foundation model of atmospheric state, covering forecasting, downscaling, and gravity-wave parameterization from one pretrained backbone.
entries.citation: Prithvi WxC — Schmude, J. et al. "Prithvi WxC: Foundation Model for Weather and Climate." arXiv 2409.13598 (2024).

entries.name: cBottle
entries.fullTitle: Climate in a Bottle: Towards a Generative Foundation Model for the Kilometer-Scale Global Atmosphere
entries.description: NVIDIA generative foundation model that samples kilometer-scale global atmospheric states, compressing a cloud-resolving climate simulator into a diffusion model.
entries.citation: cBottle — "Climate in a Bottle: Towards a Generative Foundation Model for the Kilometer-Scale Global Atmosphere." arXiv 2505.06474 (2025).

entries.name: Earth-o1
entries.fullTitle: Earth-o1: A Grid-free Observation-native Atmospheric World Model
entries.description: Models atmospheric dynamics directly from heterogeneous raw observations without forcing them onto predefined spatial grids.
entries.citation: Earth-o1 — "Earth-o1: A Grid-free Observation-native Atmospheric World Model." arXiv 2605.06337 (2026).

entries.name: VegSim
entries.fullTitle: VegSim: A Geospatial World Model for Scenario-Conditioned Vegetation Simulation
entries.description: Answers counterfactual "how would vegetation respond under alternative weather" questions rather than only forecasting the expected trajectory.
entries.citation: VegSim — "VegSim: A Geospatial World Model for Scenario-Conditioned Vegetation Simulation." arXiv 2606.21961 (2026).

entries.name: Observability Forecasting for EO
entries.fullTitle: From Surface Forecasting to Observability Forecasting: A Latent World Model for Cloud-Aware EO Monitoring
entries.description: Latent world model that predicts when Earth-observation acquisitions will actually be usable given clouds and weather drivers.
entries.citation: Observability Forecasting for EO — "From Surface Forecasting to Observability Forecasting: A Latent World Model for Cloud-Aware EO Monitoring." arXiv 2607.13651 (2026).

entries.name: Extremes on Rewind
entries.fullTitle: Extremes on Rewind: Generating 1,000-Member Ensembles Initialized at a Final Condition
entries.description: Runs generative climate emulation backwards from an observed extreme event to sample large precursor ensembles for attribution and risk analysis.
entries.citation: Extremes on Rewind — "Extremes on Rewind: Generating 1,000-Member Ensembles Initialized at a Final Condition." arXiv 2608.19008 (2026).

entries.name: M-JEPA
entries.fullTitle: Tracing the Unlabeled Storm: Cross-Variable Transfer in a Lagrangian Atmospheric JEPA Framework
entries.description: Multiscale JEPA world model of monsoon convection pretrained on continuous atmospheric proxies and transferred to precipitation prediction.
entries.citation: M-JEPA — "Tracing the Unlabeled Storm: Cross-Variable Transfer in a Lagrangian Atmospheric JEPA Framework." arXiv 2608.22358 (2026).

entries.name: Immune World Model
entries.fullTitle: An immune world model for multiscale forecasting and therapeutic hypothesis generation
entries.description: Action-conditioned multiscale model predicts how interventions change cellular, tissue, and patient immune states, including unseen perturbation combinations. Its therapeutic outputs are prospectively testable hypotheses.
entries.citation: Immune World Model — "An immune world model for multiscale forecasting and therapeutic hypothesis generation." arXiv 2609.14709 (2026).

entries.name: EchoWorld
entries.fullTitle: EchoWorld: Learning Motion-Aware World Models for Echocardiography Probe Guidance
entries.description: Predicts anatomical content and visual consequences of ultrasound-probe motion to improve sequential probe guidance.
entries.citation: EchoWorld — "EchoWorld: Learning Motion-Aware World Models for Echocardiography Probe Guidance." arXiv 2504.13065 (2025).

entries.name: AlphaFold 3
entries.fullTitle: Accurate structure prediction of biomolecular interactions with AlphaFold 3
entries.description: Generative diffusion-based world model of molecular interactions and protein structures.
entries.citation: AlphaFold 3 — Abramson, J. et al. "Accurate structure prediction of biomolecular interactions with AlphaFold 3." Nature (2024).

entries.name: CellFlux
entries.fullTitle: CellFlux: Simulating Cellular Morphology Changes via Flow Matching
entries.description: Flow-matching world model for simulating cellular morphology dynamics.
entries.citation: CellFlux — "CellFlux: Simulating Cellular Morphology Changes via Flow Matching." arXiv 2502.09775 (2025).

entries.name: Medical World Model
entries.fullTitle: Medical World Model: Generative Simulation of Tumor Evolution for Treatment Planning
entries.description: Uses generative world simulation to model tumor evolution under treatment interventions.
entries.citation: Medical World Model — "Medical World Model: Generative Simulation of Tumor Evolution for Treatment Planning." arXiv 2506.02327 (2025).

entries.name: SFP
entries.fullTitle: Spatiotemporal Forecasting as Planning: A Model-Based Reinforcement Learning Approach with Generative World Models
entries.description: Casts spatiotemporal forecasting as planning with generative world models.
entries.citation: SFP — "Spatiotemporal Forecasting as Planning: A Model-Based Reinforcement Learning Approach with Generative World Models." arXiv 2510.04020 (2025).

entries.name: Towards Biomedical World Models
entries.fullTitle: Towards World Models in Biomedical Research
entries.description: Position paper arguing for perturbation-aware biomedical world models that predict and control disease, treatment, and cellular dynamics.
entries.citation: Towards Biomedical World Models — "Towards World Models in Biomedical Research." arXiv 2606.05925 (2026).

entries.name: AI Virtual Cell
entries.fullTitle: How to Build the Virtual Cell with Artificial Intelligence: Priorities and Opportunities
entries.description: Perspective defining AI virtual cells as simulators that predict and steer cell behavior across scales and under perturbations — the world-model framing for cell biology.
entries.citation: AI Virtual Cell — Bunne, C. et al. "How to Build the Virtual Cell with Artificial Intelligence: Priorities and Opportunities." Cell (2024).

entries.name: MDGen
entries.fullTitle: Generative Modeling of Molecular Dynamics Trajectories
entries.description: Generates entire molecular-dynamics trajectories, enabling forward simulation, interpolation, upsampling, and inpainting of molecular motion as a flexible MD surrogate.
entries.citation: MDGen — Jing, B. et al. "Generative Modeling of Molecular Dynamics Trajectories." NeurIPS 2024.

entries.name: ODesign
entries.fullTitle: ODesign: A World Model for Biomolecular Interaction Design
entries.description: All-atom generative world model for designing biomolecular interactions across molecular types with entity- and token-level controllability.
entries.citation: ODesign — "ODesign: A World Model for Biomolecular Interaction Design." arXiv 2510.22304 (2025).

entries.name: HounsWorld
entries.fullTitle: HounsWorld: A Multimodal World Model for Hidden Patient-State Readout, Reconstruction, and Simulation
entries.description: Treats CT volumes and clinical language as observations of a shared latent patient state, making diagnosis, reconstruction, and simulation state-dependent predictions.
entries.citation: HounsWorld — "HounsWorld: A Multimodal World Model for Hidden Patient-State Readout, Reconstruction, and Simulation." arXiv 2608.12904 (2026).

entries.name: Mol-JEPA
entries.fullTitle: Mol-JEPA: A multimodal Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture for Molecules
entries.description: JEPA-based molecular world model using modality-crossing prediction (2D graph to 3D conformer) instead of chemically invalid augmentations.
entries.citation: Mol-JEPA — "Mol-JEPA: A multimodal Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture for Molecules." arXiv 2608.22642 (2026).

entries.name: Off-Manifold Refinement
entries.fullTitle: Off-Manifold Refinement: Guiding Video Generators with a Frozen World Model
entries.description: Guides one video-sampling trajectory with gradients of frozen V-JEPA surprise through a trained latent-to-embedding adapter, improving measured physical plausibility without updating the generator or world model.
entries.citation: Off-Manifold Refinement — "Off-Manifold Refinement: Guiding Video Generators with a Frozen World Model." arXiv 2608.29904 (2026).

entries.fullTitle: HERO: Hierarchical Extrapolation and Refresh for Efficient World Models
entries.description: Accelerates generative world-model inference with shallow-layer token refresh and deep-layer feature extrapolation.
entries.citation: HERO — "HERO: Hierarchical Extrapolation and Refresh for Efficient World Models." arXiv 2508.17588 (2025).

entries.citation: Foresight Diffusion — "Foresight Diffusion: Improving Sampling Consistency in Predictive Diffusion Models." arXiv 2505.16474 (2025).

entries.description: Studies world-model test-time scaling using token pruning, beam search, and an evaluation toolkit.
entries.citation: Can Test-Time Scaling Improve World Foundation Model? — arXiv 2503.24320 (2025).

entries.description: Distills bidirectional video diffusion into a causal generator for efficient streaming prediction and dynamic prompting.
entries.citation: From Slow Bidirectional to Fast Autoregressive Video Diffusion Models — arXiv 2412.07772 (2024).

entries.fullTitle: PAN: A World Model for General, Actionable, and Long-Horizon World Simulation
entries.description: General interactive world simulation backbone emphasizing long-horizon controllability.
entries.citation: PAN — "PAN: A World Model for General, Actionable, and Long-Horizon World Simulation." arXiv 2511.09057 (2025).

entries.name: Cosmos 3
entries.fullTitle: Cosmos 3: Omnimodal World Models for Physical AI
entries.description: NVIDIA's omnimodal Physical AI backbone unifying language, image, video, audio, and action generation/understanding in one world-model family.
entries.citation: Cosmos 3 — "Cosmos 3: Omnimodal World Models for Physical AI." arXiv 2606.02800 (2026).

entries.fullTitle: Learning How the World Evolves: Extrapolative Video World Models via Latent Dynamics Reasoning
entries.description: Casts latent transitions as explicit kinematic integration over structured latents (the model regresses only higher-order residuals), achieving out-of-distribution dynamics extrapolation with a 20× smaller ID–OOD gap at a fraction of the compute.
entries.citation: LDR — Li, H. et al. "Learning How the World Evolves: Extrapolative Video World Models via Latent Dynamics Reasoning." arXiv 2608.09926 (2026).

entries.name: Stream Forcing
entries.fullTitle: Stream Forcing: Constructing Unified Training Trajectory for Robust Streaming Video Generation
entries.description: Reformulates video diffusion sampling as a frame-indexed stochastic noise process and builds a continuous training trajectory toward inference-consistent sampling, closing the streaming train–inference mismatch that world-model rollouts inherit.
entries.citation: Stream Forcing — Zhu, Y. et al. "Stream Forcing: Constructing Unified Training Trajectory for Robust Streaming Video Generation." arXiv 2608.10439 (2026).

entries.name: ForgeWM
entries.fullTitle: ForgeWM: Progressive Causal Training for Few-Step Action-Conditioned Video World Models
entries.description: Four-stage progressive causal distillation turns bidirectional action-conditioned generators into 1/2/4-step world models that keep keyboard/mouse actions aligned with compressed latent chunks (Minecraft and gamepad FPS), plus a latency/replay-refinement dual-path deployment protocol.
entries.citation: ForgeWM — Li, X. et al. "ForgeWM: Progressive Causal Training for Few-Step Action-Conditioned Video World Models." arXiv 2608.14022 (2026).

entries.name: EchoWM
entries.fullTitle: EchoWM: Open and Enterable Omnimodal World Models
entries.description: Open "enterable" world model responding to continuous navigation via a shared metric-scale 6-DoF trajectory interface while jointly generating 720p video with synchronized environmental sound, music, and speech over long-horizon autoregressive rollouts.
entries.citation: EchoWM — Zhang, S. et al. "EchoWM: Open and Enterable Omnimodal World Models." arXiv 2608.23189 (2026).

entries.name: ShotStream
entries.fullTitle: ShotStream: Streaming Multi-Shot Video Generation for Interactive Storytelling
entries.description: Carries a global cache of sparsely selected conditional frames from earlier shots into causal streaming generation of each next shot, accepting newly injected story prompts after prior shots are already generated, so the narrative can be steered mid-rollout rather than fixed in an offline script.
entries.citation: ShotStream — "ShotStream: Streaming Multi-Shot Video Generation for Interactive Storytelling." arXiv 2603.25746 (2026).
categoryPath: 1.7 🎬 Persistent Narrative & Multi-Shot Video World Models

entries.name: CausalCine
entries.fullTitle: CausalCine: Real-Time Autoregressive Generation for Multi-Shot Video Narratives
entries.description: Turns multi-shot generation into an online directing process: a causal model trained on native multi-shot sequences accepts dynamic prompts on the fly, generates across shot boundaries, and routes cross-shot memory by attention relevance (CAMR) under a bounded active cache.
entries.citation: CausalCine — Meng, Y. et al. "CausalCine: Real-Time Autoregressive Generation for Multi-Shot Video Narratives." arXiv 2605.12496 (2026).
categoryPath: 1.7 🎬 Persistent Narrative & Multi-Shot Video World Models

entries.name: ContextMaster
entries.fullTitle: ContextMaster: Interactive Multi-Shot Video Creation via Fixed-Budget Sparse Context Routing
entries.description: Formalizes interactive multi-shot video creation: one model generates, follows references, or edits footage while maintaining a shared expanding history accessed through fixed-budget sparse context routing, running at 16 FPS after privileged context distillation.
entries.citation: ContextMaster — Guo, X. et al. "ContextMaster: Interactive Multi-Shot Video Creation via Fixed-Budget Sparse Context Routing." arXiv 2608.04956 (2026).
categoryPath: 1.7 🎬 Persistent Narrative & Multi-Shot Video World Models

entries.name: Vorch-Director
entries.fullTitle: Vorch-Director: Interactive World Story Model via Noise-Aware Error Rectification
entries.description: Continues a world story by conditioning each extension on its own previously generated audio-visual history, with noise-level-aware residual correction to keep multi-shot, multi-subject, reference-guided rollouts stable at minute scale.
entries.citation: Vorch-Director — Zhang, L. et al. "Vorch-Director: Interactive World Story Model via Noise-Aware Error Rectification." arXiv 2608.05776 (2026).
categoryPath: 1.7 🎬 Persistent Narrative & Multi-Shot Video World Models

entries.name: StoryMem
entries.fullTitle: StoryMem: Multi-shot Long Video Storytelling with Memory
entries.description: Keeps a dynamically updated memory of keyframes selected from previously generated shots and conditions a memory-to-video model on it when producing each subsequent shot under its own prompt, so later shots inherit scene and character appearance from earlier ones.
entries.citation: StoryMem — "StoryMem: Multi-shot Long Video Storytelling with Memory." arXiv 2512.19539 (2025).
categoryPath: 1.7 🎬 Persistent Narrative & Multi-Shot Video World Models

entries.name: OneStory
entries.fullTitle: OneStory: Coherent Multi-Shot Video Generation with Adaptive Memory
entries.description: Selects caption-relevant latent frames from prior shots as an adaptive memory and conditions each new shot on them under its per-shot prompt, propagating visual context across shot boundaries inside the model rather than generating independent clips.
entries.citation: OneStory — "OneStory: Coherent Multi-Shot Video Generation with Adaptive Memory." CVPR 2026.
categoryPath: 1.7 🎬 Persistent Narrative & Multi-Shot Video World Models

entries.name: FilmWeaver
entries.fullTitle: FilmWeaver: Weaving Consistent Multi-Shot Videos with Cache-Guided Autoregressive Diffusion
entries.description: Feeds a dual-level cache into each autoregressively generated next shot — prior-shot keyframes for cross-shot identity and scene context, plus recent within-shot frame history for motion continuity — enabling arbitrary-length multi-shot rollouts whose later shots consume context from earlier ones.
entries.citation: FilmWeaver — "FilmWeaver: Weaving Consistent Multi-Shot Videos with Cache-Guided Autoregressive Diffusion." AAAI 2026.
categoryPath: 1.7 🎬 Persistent Narrative & Multi-Shot Video World Models

entries.name: STAGE (narrative)
entries.fullTitle: STAGE: Storyboard-Anchored Generation for Cinematic Multi-shot Narrative
entries.description: Conditions each subsequent shot on an entity-consistency memory pack gathered from earlier shots together with predicted start/end storyboard anchors, rendering the narrative script as anchored multi-shot rollouts rather than independently prompted clips. (Distinct from the driving world model STAGE in §1.2.1.)
entries.citation: STAGE (narrative) — "STAGE: Storyboard-Anchored Generation for Cinematic Multi-shot Narrative." CVPR 2026.
categoryPath: 1.7 🎬 Persistent Narrative & Multi-Shot Video World Models

entries.name: Make-A-Story
entries.fullTitle: Make-A-Story: Visual Memory Conditioned Consistent Story Generation
entries.description: Story-visualization precursor (still images, not video): an autoregressive visual memory over previously generated frames and sentences resolves co-references and keeps actor and background appearance consistent across the frame sequence.
entries.citation: Make-A-Story — "Make-A-Story: Visual Memory Conditioned Consistent Story Generation." CVPR 2023.
categoryPath: 1.7 🎬 Persistent Narrative & Multi-Shot Video World Models

entries.name: EM-Vid
entries.fullTitle: EM-Vid: Training-Free Entity-Centric Memory for Efficient and Consistent Multi-Shot Video Generation
entries.description: Replaces full-frame history with an entity-indexed bank of latent patches under a budgeted update strategy; each new shot attends sparsely only to entity-relevant memory tokens, disentangling persistent entity state from transient scene context.
entries.citation: EM-Vid — Vandersanden, J. et al. "EM-Vid: Training-Free Entity-Centric Memory for Efficient and Consistent Multi-Shot Video Generation." arXiv 2605.23610 (2026).
categoryPath: 1.7 🎬 Persistent Narrative & Multi-Shot Video World Models

entries.name: GroundShot
entries.fullTitle: GroundShot: Visually Consistent Multi-Shot Long Video Generation via Entity-Grounded Shot Scheduling
entries.description: Builds an entity-level visual memory online from accepted generated shots — grounding, verifying, and retrieving entity references — and schedules shot generation order by expected reference usefulness, with the GroundBench entity-consistency diagnostic.
entries.citation: GroundShot — Lai, Y. et al. "GroundShot: Visually Consistent Multi-Shot Long Video Generation via Entity-Grounded Shot Scheduling." arXiv 2606.20799 (2026).
categoryPath: 1.7 🎬 Persistent Narrative & Multi-Shot Video World Models

entries.name: UnityShots
entries.fullTitle: UnityShots: Memory-Driven Multi-Shot Audio-Video Generation with Boundary-Aware Gating
entries.description: Maintains fixed-size long-term (opening-shot anchor) and short-term (previous tail) memory slots updated at every cut by a boundary-conditioned gate fusing cut probability and beat signals, with a speaker token persisting voice identity across shots.
entries.citation: UnityShots — Huang, J. et al. "UnityShots: Memory-Driven Multi-Shot Audio-Video Generation with Boundary-Aware Gating." arXiv 2606.21661 (2026).
categoryPath: 1.7 🎬 Persistent Narrative & Multi-Shot Video World Models

entries.name: SlotMem
entries.fullTitle: SlotMem: Character-Addressable Internal Memory for Narrative Long Video Generation
entries.description: Character-addressable slot memory: a semantic probe localizes character tokens, a memory writer conservatively updates each character's compact slot as generation proceeds, and character-wise cross-attention re-injects the right memory across scene transitions and long temporal gaps.
entries.citation: SlotMem — Liu, Y. et al. "SlotMem: Character-Addressable Internal Memory for Narrative Long Video Generation." arXiv 2607.15772 (2026).
categoryPath: 1.7 🎬 Persistent Narrative & Multi-Shot Video World Models

entries.name: JoyAI-Echo-1.5
entries.fullTitle: Long-Horizon Audio-Visual Generation for Persistent Stories and Interactive Worlds
entries.description: Unified system whose long-video variant aggregates composable cross-shot memory (multi-shot visual evidence plus speech-filtered speaker cues) for persistent character appearance and voice, while a world-model variant adds calibrated metric 6-DoF navigation control (ranked first on WBench).
entries.citation: JoyAI-Echo-1.5 — Duan, N. et al. "Long-Horizon Audio-Visual Generation for Persistent Stories and Interactive Worlds." arXiv 2608.23383 (2026).
categoryPath: 1.7 🎬 Persistent Narrative & Multi-Shot Video World Models

entries.name: FilmWorld
entries.fullTitle: FilmWorld: Agentic Novel-to-Film Generation through Dynamic Cinematic World Modeling
entries.description: Formalizes novel-to-film generation as dynamic cinematic world modeling. Specialized agents construct persistent world entities, propagate their states across scenes, plan shots from those states, and verify cross-shot causal and visual consistency in a closed loop.
entries.citation: FilmWorld — Zuo, J. et al. "FilmWorld: Agentic Novel-to-Film Generation through Dynamic Cinematic World Modeling." arXiv 2607.19038 (2026).
categoryPath: 1.7 🎬 Persistent Narrative & Multi-Shot Video World Models

entries.name: MovieDreamer
entries.fullTitle: MovieDreamer: Hierarchical Generation for Coherent Long Visual Sequence
entries.description: Builds a multimodal script — character descriptions with face embeddings, scene elements, and plot — and autoregressively predicts later keyframes conditioned on it before diffusion renders each clip, planning long multi-scene narratives instead of prompting shots independently.
entries.citation: MovieDreamer — "MovieDreamer: Hierarchical Generation for Coherent Long Visual Sequence." ICLR 2025.
categoryPath: 1.7 🎬 Persistent Narrative & Multi-Shot Video World Models

entries.name: VideoDirectorGPT
entries.fullTitle: VideoDirectorGPT: Consistent Multi-scene Video Generation via LLM-Guided Planning
entries.description: Generates an upfront LLM video plan — scene descriptions, entity lists, per-scene layouts, and consistency groupings marking which entities recur — and feeds it to a layout-guided renderer for each scene, coordinating multi-scene generation through the shared plan rather than a list of independent shot prompts.
entries.citation: VideoDirectorGPT — "VideoDirectorGPT: Consistent Multi-scene Video Generation via LLM-Guided Planning." COLM 2024.
categoryPath: 1.7 🎬 Persistent Narrative & Multi-Shot Video World Models

entries.name: ReCA
entries.fullTitle: ReCA: Multi-Shot Long Video Extrapolation via Recursive Context Allocation
entries.description: Defines multi-shot video extrapolation — continuing an observed anchor state through cinematically structured shots — and solves it with recursive context allocation that decomposes planning/generation into context-bounded subproblems and propagates structured state updates across frozen-generator calls.
entries.citation: ReCA — Liu, A. et al. "ReCA: Multi-Shot Long Video Extrapolation via Recursive Context Allocation." arXiv 2605.26525 (2026).
categoryPath: 1.7 🎬 Persistent Narrative & Multi-Shot Video World Models

entries.name: JEPLO
entries.fullTitle: JEPLO: Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning for LiDAR-Based Legged Locomotion
entries.description: Learns predictive terrain representations from LiDAR and proprioception with a JEPA teacher-student pipeline for robust legged locomotion and sim-to-real transfer.
entries.citation: JEPLO — "JEPLO: Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning for LiDAR-Based Legged Locomotion." arXiv 2609.15770 (2026).

entries.name: GLAM
entries.fullTitle: GLAM: Training a latent world model over global spatiotemporal memory for active exploration and navigation
entries.description: Jointly predicts future map tokens and waypoint latents from global spatial memory and a navigation goal, supporting exploration and ObjectNav without future RGB reconstruction.
entries.citation: GLAM — "GLAM: Training a latent world model over global spatiotemporal memory for active exploration and navigation." arXiv 2609.14561 (2026).

entries.name: DUET-DINO
entries.fullTitle: DUET-DINO: Simultaneous Cross-View World Modeling for Latent Planning in Robot Manipulation
entries.description: Jointly predicts action-conditioned side- and wrist-camera representations for full 7-DoF latent planning, exploiting complementary scene and gripper views during manipulation.
entries.citation: DUET-DINO — "DUET-DINO: Simultaneous Cross-View World Modeling for Latent Planning in Robot Manipulation." arXiv 2609.10506 (2026).

entries.name: Semigroup-JEPA
entries.fullTitle: Semigroup-JEPA: Latent Dynamics Consistency for Zero-Shot Physics Generalization
entries.description: Conditions latent dynamics on physical parameters and backpropagates multi-step rollout losses into the encoder to improve prediction and control under unseen gravitational regimes.
entries.citation: Semigroup-JEPA — "Semigroup-JEPA: Latent Dynamics Consistency for Zero-Shot Physics Generalization." arXiv 2609.10464 (2026).

entries.name: Coupled Control and Wireless WMs
entries.fullTitle: Coupled Control and Wireless World Models for Resilient Remote Robotic Control
entries.description: Couples JEPA models of robot dynamics and wireless-channel evolution for predictive communication scheduling and adaptation under visual and radio disturbances.
entries.citation: Coupled Control and Wireless WMs — "Coupled Control and Wireless World Models for Resilient Remote Robotic Control." arXiv 2609.04851 (2026).

entries.name: Physically Grounded JEPA
entries.fullTitle: Toward Physically Grounded JEPA World Models for Goal-Conditioned Robotic Planning
entries.description: Adds inverse dynamics and physical-state alignment to latent prediction, preserving action-relevant transitions and improving visually goal-conditioned robot planning.
entries.citation: Physically Grounded JEPA — "Toward Physically Grounded JEPA World Models for Goal-Conditioned Robotic Planning." arXiv 2609.03565 (2026).

entries.name: Spectral-Target Latent Structuring
entries.fullTitle: Spectral-Target Physical Latent Structuring for JEPA-Style World Models
entries.description: Adds a training-only Fourier auxiliary head to discourage physically uninformative JEPA representations and improve latent-space planning in dynamic and low-data settings.
entries.citation: Spectral-Target Latent Structuring — "Spectral-Target Physical Latent Structuring for JEPA-Style World Models." arXiv 2609.04264 (2026).

entries.name: Point-Cloud JEPA Planning
entries.fullTitle: Does Latent Planning Survive Point Clouds? Action-Conditioned JEPA World Models for Geometric Observations
entries.description: Tests three action-conditioned JEPA designs on geometric observations and demonstrates latent planning, robustness to point dropout, and direct 3D target specification without goal images.
entries.citation: Point-Cloud JEPA Planning — "Does Latent Planning Survive Point Clouds? Action-Conditioned JEPA World Models for Geometric Observations." arXiv 2608.29434 (2026).

entries.name: Flow-JEPA
entries.fullTitle: Flow-JEPA: Flow Matching for Robust Latent Dynamics in JEPA World Models
entries.description: Replaces deterministic one-step latent regression with conditional flow matching over future latent trajectories, improving goal-conditioned control robustness under visual noise.
entries.citation: Flow-JEPA — "Flow-JEPA: Flow Matching for Robust Latent Dynamics in JEPA World Models." arXiv 2608.29029 (2026).

entries.name: LeVJEPA
entries.fullTitle: LeVJEPA: Efficient & Scalable Video Pretraining without the Heuristics
entries.description: Extends LeJEPA-style regularization to efficient video representation pretraining with random token dropping and optional causal attention; an architectural foundation rather than an action-conditioned simulator.
entries.citation: LeVJEPA — "LeVJEPA: Efficient & Scalable Video Pretraining without the Heuristics." arXiv 2608.27395 (2026).

entries.name: Successive Capacity Growth
entries.fullTitle: Successive Capacity Growth: Task-Complexity-Driven Width and Depth Expansion for Vision Transformer Encoders in JEPA World Models
entries.description: Expands JEPA encoder width or depth through function-preserving trials and prediction-loss checks, studying adaptive model capacity for navigation and multi-object dynamics.
entries.citation: Successive Capacity Growth — "Successive Capacity Growth: Task-Complexity-Driven Width and Depth Expansion for Vision Transformer Encoders in JEPA World Models." arXiv 2608.27367 (2026).

entries.name: JEPA-x
entries.fullTitle: JEPA-x: Cross-Predictive Physics Grounding for Forecastable Latent Dynamics
entries.description: Cross-predicts visual and privileged physical-state trajectories through shared dynamics during training, grounding latent transitions while retaining vision-only deployment.
entries.citation: JEPA-x — "JEPA-x: Cross-Predictive Physics Grounding for Forecastable Latent Dynamics." arXiv 2608.24044 (2026).

entries.name: LpWM
entries.fullTitle: LpWM: A Case for Sparse Representations in World Models
entries.description: Regularizes JEPA features toward nonnegative sparse distributions, reducing the predictor capacity needed for planning and separating discrete dynamical regimes from continuous within-regime state.
entries.citation: LpWM — "LpWM: A Case for Sparse Representations in World Models." arXiv 2608.22764 (2026).

entries.name: Demo-JEPA
entries.fullTitle: Demo-JEPA: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for One-shot Cross-Embodiment Imitation
entries.description: Transforms cross-embodiment visual demonstrations into future latent subgoals for planning under the target robot's own dynamics.
entries.citation: Demo-JEPA — "Demo-JEPA: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for One-shot Cross-Embodiment Imitation." arXiv 2605.20811 (2026).

entries.name: A Lightweight Library for Energy-Based Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures
entries.fullTitle: A Lightweight Library for Energy-Based Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures
entries.description: Provides modular JEPA implementations spanning image representation learning, temporal prediction, and action-conditioned planning.
entries.citation: A Lightweight Library for Energy-Based Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures — arXiv 2602.03604 (2026).

entries.name: seq-JEPA
entries.fullTitle: seq-JEPA: Autoregressive Predictive Learning of Invariant-Equivariant World Models
entries.description: Autoregressively predicts transformed visual embeddings while separating invariant and equivariant representations.
entries.citation: seq-JEPA — "seq-JEPA: Autoregressive Predictive Learning of Invariant-Equivariant World Models." arXiv 2505.03176 (2025).

entries.name: CheXWorld
entries.fullTitle: CheXWorld: Exploring Image World Modeling for Radiograph Representation Learning
entries.description: Applies predictive image-world-model pretraining to radiographs, modeling anatomy, layout, and appearance-domain transformations.
entries.citation: CheXWorld — "CheXWorld: Exploring Image World Modeling for Radiograph Representation Learning." arXiv 2504.13820 (2025).

entries.name: EgoAgent
entries.fullTitle: EgoAgent: A Joint Predictive Agent Model in Egocentric Worlds
entries.description: Jointly learns egocentric representations, future states, and actions with a temporally asymmetric predictive architecture.
entries.citation: EgoAgent — "EgoAgent: A Joint Predictive Agent Model in Egocentric Worlds." arXiv 2502.05857 (2025).

entries.name: Learning and Leveraging World Models in Visual Representation Learning
entries.fullTitle: Learning and Leveraging World Models in Visual Representation Learning
entries.description: Extends JEPA to predict photometric transformations in latent space and studies controllable invariance and equivariance in learned representations.
entries.citation: Learning and Leveraging World Models in Visual Representation Learning — arXiv 2403.00504 (2024).

entries.name: Temporal-Distance JEPA
entries.fullTitle: Temporal-Distance JEPA: Plan-Aware Representation Learning for Latent World Model Predictive Control
entries.description: Learns a directed temporal-progress cost from reward-free trajectories and aligns representation learning with the multi-step ranking requirements of latent model-predictive control.
entries.citation: Temporal-Distance JEPA — Bai, J. & Xiong, J. "Temporal-Distance JEPA: Plan-Aware Representation Learning for Latent World Model Predictive Control." arXiv 2607.25337 (2026).

entries.name: Controlled World Model Identifiability
entries.fullTitle: On the Identifiability of Controlled World Models
entries.description: Establishes joint representation and transition identifiability conditions under which LeJEPA-style predictive objectives recover latent states and controlled dynamics up to an orthogonal transformation.
entries.citation: Controlled World Model Identifiability — Zhang, X. et al. "On the Identifiability of Controlled World Models." arXiv 2607.22430 (2026).

entries.name: I-JEPA
entries.fullTitle: Self-Supervised Learning from Images with a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture
entries.description: Predicts context representations of masked image patches; strong linear-probe performance without pixel decoding.
entries.citation: I-JEPA — Assran, M. et al. "Self-Supervised Learning from Images with a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture." CVPR 2023.

entries.name: V-JEPA
entries.fullTitle: Revisiting Feature Prediction for Learning Visual Representations from Video
entries.description: Learns video representations by predicting masked spatiotemporal features in latent space, providing a predictive representation backbone for downstream visual understanding.
entries.citation: V-JEPA — Bardes, A. et al. "Revisiting Feature Prediction for Learning Visual Representations from Video." TMLR 2024 (Featured Certification).

entries.name: V-JEPA 2
entries.fullTitle: V-JEPA 2: Self-Supervised Video Models Enable Understanding, Prediction and Planning
entries.description: Milestone. Pretrains on >1M hours of video, enables zero-shot robotic manipulation via latent action-conditioned planning with <62h robot video.
entries.citation: V-JEPA 2 — Assran, M. et al. "V-JEPA 2: Self-Supervised Video Models Enable Understanding, Prediction and Planning." arXiv 2506.09985 (2025).

entries.name: V-JEPA 2.1
entries.fullTitle: V-JEPA 2.1: Unlocking Dense Features in Video Self-Supervised Learning
entries.description: Updates V-JEPA with denser video features, improving its usefulness as a predictive representation backbone.
entries.citation: V-JEPA 2.1 — "V-JEPA 2.1: Unlocking Dense Features in Video Self-Supervised Learning." arXiv 2603.14482 (2026).

entries.name: LeWorldModel / LeWM
entries.fullTitle: LeWorldModel: Stable End-to-End Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture from Pixels
entries.description: Stable end-to-end JEPA world model from raw pixels with action-conditioned latent prediction, fast planning, and compact single-GPU training.
entries.citation: LeWorldModel / LeWM — "LeWorldModel: Stable End-to-End Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture from Pixels." arXiv 2603.19312 (2026).

entries.name: Fast LeWorldModel
entries.fullTitle: Fast LeWorldModel
entries.description: Replaces autoregressive one-step LeWM rollouts with parallel action-prefix latent prediction, reducing planning latency and long-horizon error accumulation.
entries.citation: Fast LeWorldModel — "Fast LeWorldModel." arXiv 2606.26217 (2026).

entries.name: SkyJEPA
entries.fullTitle: SkyJEPA: Learning Long-Horizon World Models for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Control of Quadrotors
entries.description: JEPA-style latent dynamics model for real-time quadrotor control, pairing physically interpretable probing with sampling-based optimal control for zero-shot sim-to-real transfer.
entries.citation: SkyJEPA — "SkyJEPA: Learning Long-Horizon World Models for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Control of Quadrotors." arXiv 2606.23444 (2026).

entries.name: AdaJEPA
entries.fullTitle: AdaJEPA: An Adaptive Latent World Model
entries.description: Adapts latent dynamics online during model-predictive control, using observed transitions as self-supervision for changing environments.
entries.citation: AdaJEPA — "AdaJEPA: An Adaptive Latent World Model." arXiv 2606.32026 (2026).

entries.name: Delta-JEPA
entries.fullTitle: Delta-JEPA: Learning Action-Sensitive World Models via Latent Difference Decoding
entries.description: Decodes action-sensitive latent differences to make the predictive representation reflect controllable state changes rather than action-insensitive dynamics.
entries.citation: Delta-JEPA — "Delta-JEPA: Learning Action-Sensitive World Models via Latent Difference Decoding." arXiv 2606.31232 (2026).

entries.name: Qantara
entries.fullTitle: Qantara: Bridge-Flow Training for Multi-Paradigm JEPA Control
entries.description: Trains one JEPA checkpoint to support latent planning, behavior cloning, and inverse dynamics through bridge-flow objectives.
entries.citation: Qantara — "Qantara: Bridge-Flow Training for Multi-Paradigm JEPA Control." arXiv 2607.04978 (2026).

entries.name: FF-JEPA
entries.fullTitle: FF-JEPA: Long-Horizon Planning in World Models with Latent Planners
entries.description: Adds an action-free latent planner on top of JEPA dynamics to decompose long-horizon planning without requiring an explicit goal image.
entries.citation: FF-JEPA — "FF-JEPA: Long-Horizon Planning in World Models with Latent Planners." arXiv 2606.09311 (2026).

entries.name: Branch-JEPA
entries.fullTitle: Branch-JEPA: Finite-Support Predictive Distributions for JEPA World Models
entries.description: Represents each transition as a weighted finite set of latent successors, retaining all branches at inference and supporting both specialization and full-set Energy-Score training for stochastic futures.
entries.citation: Branch-JEPA — "Branch-JEPA: Finite-Support Predictive Distributions for JEPA World Models." arXiv 2607.05238 (2026).

entries.name: LeJEPA Theory
entries.fullTitle: When Does LeJEPA Learn a World Model?
entries.description: Provides identifiability conditions under which JEPA-style embeddings recover latent world variables useful for planning.
entries.citation: LeJEPA Theory — Klindt, D., LeCun, Y. & Balestriero, R. "When Does LeJEPA Learn a World Model?" arXiv 2605.26379 (2026).

entries.name: JEPA Generalization Theory
entries.fullTitle: A Generalization Theory for JEPA-Based World Models
entries.description: Connects JEPA pretraining error to downstream planning regret through a finite-sample generalization analysis of action-conditioned latent prediction.
entries.citation: JEPA Generalization Theory — "A Generalization Theory for JEPA-Based World Models." arXiv 2606.27014 (2026).

entries.name: V-JEPA Learns Intuitive Physics
entries.fullTitle: Intuitive physics understanding emerges from self-supervised pretraining on natural videos
entries.description: Evidence that JEPA-style video pretraining can induce physical prediction useful for world modeling.
entries.citation: V-JEPA Learns Intuitive Physics — "Intuitive physics understanding emerges from self-supervised pretraining on natural videos." arXiv 2502.11831 (2025).

entries.name: DINO-World
entries.fullTitle: Back to the Features: DINO as a Foundation for Video World Models
entries.description: Shows that strong pretrained visual features can serve as the foundation for video world modeling.
entries.citation: DINO-World — "Back to the Features: DINO as a Foundation for Video World Models." arXiv 2507.19468 (2025).

entries.name: DINO-Foresight
entries.fullTitle: DINO-Foresight: Looking into the Future with DINO
entries.description: Predicts future DINO/VFM feature trajectories for autonomous-driving scene understanding, avoiding pixel-level rollout cost while keeping downstream heads usable.
entries.citation: DINO-Foresight — "DINO-Foresight: Looking into the Future with DINO." NeurIPS 2025.

entries.name: MC-JEPA
entries.fullTitle: MC-JEPA: A Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for Self-Supervised Learning of Motion and Content Features
entries.citation: MC-JEPA — "MC-JEPA: A Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for Self-Supervised Learning of Motion and Content Features." arXiv 2307.12698 (2023).

entries.name: A-JEPA
entries.fullTitle: A-JEPA: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture Can Listen
entries.description: Predicts masked audio-spectrogram representations with time-frequency-aware masking for self-supervised audio learning.
entries.citation: A-JEPA — "A-JEPA: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture Can Listen." arXiv 2311.15830 (2023).

entries.name: Hierarchical JEPA
entries.fullTitle: Hierarchical World Models as Visual Whole-Body Humanoid Controllers
entries.description: Multi-level JEPA world models controlling full humanoid body; imagination-based whole-body planning.
entries.citation: Hierarchical JEPA — "Hierarchical World Models as Visual Whole-Body Humanoid Controllers." arXiv 2405.18418 (2024).

entries.name: LeJEPA
entries.fullTitle: LeJEPA: Provable and Scalable Self-Supervised Learning Without the Heuristics
entries.description: The original LeJEPA paper (referenced by several §2.2 entries but missing itself). Proves the isotropic Gaussian is the optimal JEPA embedding distribution and enforces it with SIGReg, removing stop-gradients, teacher-student EMA, and schedulers.
entries.citation: LeJEPA — Balestriero, R. & LeCun, Y. "LeJEPA: Provable and Scalable Self-Supervised Learning Without the Heuristics." arXiv 2511.08544 (2025).

entries.name: PSG-JEPA
entries.fullTitle: Is Forward Prediction Enough? Physical State Grounding for JEPA World Models
entries.description: Adds training-only grounding objectives that tie individual latents to robot proprioceptive state and latent pairs to multi-horizon joint-angle changes, improving probing, latent planning, and policy learning.
entries.citation: PSG-JEPA — "Is Forward Prediction Enough? Physical State Grounding for JEPA World Models." arXiv 2608.06799 (2026).

entries.name: AC-MTM
entries.fullTitle: No Gaussian Required: Contrastive Inverse Dynamics for JEPA World Models
entries.description: Replaces LeWM's SIGReg anti-collapse regularizer with a training-only Action-NCE inverse-dynamics head; a collapsed encoder provably fails the action-discrimination task, so no prescribed embedding geometry is needed.
entries.citation: AC-MTM — "No Gaussian Required: Contrastive Inverse Dynamics for JEPA World Models." arXiv 2608.17542 (2026).

entries.name: Orthogonal JEPA
entries.fullTitle: Orthogonal JEPA: Factorized Predictive States for Latent World Models
entries.description: Replaces the monolithic JEPA target with orthogonally factorized predictive components synthesized back into a full latent state, evaluated across vision, control, health records, and molecular dynamics.
entries.citation: Orthogonal JEPA — "Orthogonal JEPA: Factorized Predictive States for Latent World Models." arXiv 2608.20065 (2026).

entries.name: Navigation-Guided Sparse Scene Representation for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
entries.fullTitle: Navigation-Guided Sparse Scene Representation for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
entries.description: Uses sparse navigation-guided scene tokens and self-supervised future-scene alignment for efficient end-to-end driving.
entries.citation: Navigation-Guided Sparse Scene Representation for End-to-End Autonomous Driving — arXiv 2409.18341 (2024).

entries.name: CarFormer
entries.fullTitle: CarFormer: Self-Driving with Learned Object-Centric Representations
entries.description: Learns object-centric BEV slots for driving and predicts their future evolution with a transformer world model.
entries.citation: CarFormer — "CarFormer: Self-Driving with Learned Object-Centric Representations." arXiv 2407.15843 (2024).

entries.name: Enhancing End-to-End Autonomous Driving with Latent World Model
entries.fullTitle: Enhancing End-to-End Autonomous Driving with Latent World Model
entries.description: Predicts future driving-scene features conditioned on ego trajectories as self-supervision for end-to-end planning.
entries.citation: Enhancing End-to-End Autonomous Driving with Latent World Model — arXiv 2406.08481 (2024).

entries.name: DriveWorld
entries.fullTitle: DriveWorld: 4D Pre-trained Scene Understanding via World Models for Autonomous Driving
entries.description: Pretrains driving representations with dynamic memory for future-state prediction and static scene propagation for spatial context.
entries.citation: DriveWorld — "DriveWorld: 4D Pre-trained Scene Understanding via World Models for Autonomous Driving." arXiv 2405.04390 (2024).

entries.name: BEVWorld
entries.fullTitle: BEVWorld: A Multimodal World Simulator for Autonomous Driving via Scene-Level BEV Latents
entries.citation: BEVWorld — "BEVWorld: A Multimodal World Simulator for Autonomous Driving via Scene-Level BEV Latents." arXiv 2407.05679 (2024).

entries.name: OccSora
entries.fullTitle: OccSora: 4D Occupancy Generation Models as World Simulators for Autonomous Driving
entries.citation: OccSora — "OccSora: 4D Occupancy Generation Models as World Simulators for Autonomous Driving." arXiv 2405.20337 (2024).

entries.name: Think2Drive
entries.fullTitle: Think2Drive: Efficient Reinforcement Learning by Thinking in Latent World Model for Quasi-Realistic Autonomous Driving (in CARLA-v2)
entries.citation: Think2Drive — "Think2Drive: Efficient Reinforcement Learning by Thinking in Latent World Model for Quasi-Realistic Autonomous Driving (in CARLA-v2)." arXiv 2402.16720 (2024).

entries.name: HoloDrive
entries.fullTitle: HoloDrive: Holistic 2D-3D Multi-Modal Street Scene Generation for Autonomous Driving
entries.description: Jointly generates camera images and LiDAR point clouds and extends the multimodal model to predict future driving states.
entries.citation: HoloDrive — "HoloDrive: Holistic 2D-3D Multi-Modal Street Scene Generation for Autonomous Driving." arXiv 2412.01407 (2024).

entries.name: Enhancing Physical Consistency
entries.fullTitle: Enhancing Physical Consistency in Lightweight World Models
entries.citation: Enhancing Physical Consistency — "Enhancing Physical Consistency in Lightweight World Models." arXiv 2509.12437 (2025).

entries.name: Unified Driving Tokens
entries.fullTitle: Unified Driving Tokens: Representation- and Geometry-Guided Discrete Tokenizer for Driving World Models and Planning
entries.description: Builds a driving-specific tokenizer that preserves geometric and planning-relevant information for token-based world modeling.
entries.citation: Unified Driving Tokens — "Unified Driving Tokens: Representation- and Geometry-Guided Discrete Tokenizer for Driving World Models and Planning." arXiv 2606.01935 (2026).

entries.name: Tesla Occupancy Networks
entries.fullTitle: Occupancy Networks
entries.description: Primary technical material on Tesla's production occupancy networks: multi-camera volumetric occupancy plus occupancy flow prediction for general obstacle avoidance (non-arXiv industry source; expanded at Tesla AI Day 2022).
entries.citation: Tesla Occupancy Networks — Elluswamy, A. "Occupancy Networks." Tesla, CVPR 2022 Workshop on Autonomous Driving keynote (2022).
entries.venue: Tesla, CVPR 2022 Workshop on Autonomous Driving keynote

entries.name: Differentiable Raycasting for Self-Supervised Occupancy Forecasting
entries.fullTitle: Differentiable Raycasting for Self-supervised Occupancy Forecasting
entries.description: Learns ego-conditioned freespace/occupancy forecasting from raw LiDAR sweeps via differentiable raycasting, letting occupancy emerge without labels.
entries.citation: Differentiable Raycasting for Self-Supervised Occupancy Forecasting — Khurana, T. et al. ECCV 2022.

entries.name: MILE
entries.fullTitle: Model-Based Imitation Learning for Urban Driving
entries.description: Jointly learns compact visual dynamics and a driving policy from offline demonstrations, enabling action sequences predicted in imagination.
entries.citation: MILE — Hu, A. et al. "Model-Based Imitation Learning for Urban Driving." NeurIPS 2022.

entries.name: Point Cloud Forecasting as a Proxy for 4D Occupancy Forecasting
entries.fullTitle: Point Cloud Forecasting as a Proxy for 4D Occupancy Forecasting
entries.description: Forecasts a 4D spacetime occupancy field and renders point clouds from it, factoring sensor extrinsics out of self-supervised world modeling; basis of the CVPR Argoverse occupancy forecasting challenge (already listed under Workshops).
entries.citation: Point Cloud Forecasting as a Proxy for 4D Occupancy Forecasting — Khurana, T. et al. CVPR 2023.

entries.name: StreamingFlow
entries.fullTitle: StreamingFlow: Streaming Occupancy Forecasting with Asynchronous Multi-modal Data Streams via Neural Ordinary Differential Equation
entries.description: Neural-ODE BEV state evolution that forecasts occupancy continuously in time from asynchronous camera and LiDAR streams.
entries.citation: StreamingFlow — "StreamingFlow: Streaming Occupancy Forecasting with Asynchronous Multi-modal Data Streams via Neural Ordinary Differential Equation." arXiv 2302.09585 (2023).

entries.name: Cam4DOcc
entries.fullTitle: Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D Occupancy Forecasting in Autonomous Driving Applications
entries.description: Standard benchmark and baselines for forecasting how 3D occupancy evolves from camera input only (could alternatively be routed to Benchmarks & Evaluation).
entries.citation: Cam4DOcc — "Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D Occupancy Forecasting in Autonomous Driving Applications." CVPR 2024.
