entries.citation: GraphWorld — "GraphWorld: Long-Horizon Planning with World Models for End-to-End Autonomous Driving." arXiv 2606.16274 (2026).

entries.name: World4Drive
entries.fullTitle: World4Drive: End-to-End Autonomous Driving via Intention-aware Physical Latent World Model
entries.citation: World4Drive — "World4Drive: End-to-End Autonomous Driving via Intention-aware Physical Latent World Model." arXiv 2507.00603 (2025).

entries.name: Doe-1
entries.fullTitle: Doe-1: Closed-Loop Autonomous Driving with Large World Model
entries.citation: Doe-1 — "Doe-1: Closed-Loop Autonomous Driving with Large World Model." arXiv 2412.09627 (2024).

entries.name: WorldDrive
entries.fullTitle: Bridging Scene Generation and Planning: Driving with World Model via Unifying Vision and Motion Representation
entries.description: A strong 2026 example of coupling scene generation, motion representation, and real-time planning in one framework.
entries.citation: WorldDrive — "Bridging Scene Generation and Planning: Driving with World Model via Unifying Vision and Motion Representation." arXiv 2603.14948 (2026).

entries.name: Raw2Drive
entries.fullTitle: Raw2Drive: Reinforcement Learning with Aligned World Models for End-to-End Autonomous Driving (in CARLA v2)
entries.citation: Raw2Drive — "Raw2Drive: Reinforcement Learning with Aligned World Models for End-to-End Autonomous Driving (in CARLA v2)." arXiv 2505.16394 (2025).

entries.name: ImagiDrive
entries.fullTitle: ImagiDrive: A Unified Imagination-and-Planning Framework for Autonomous Driving
entries.description: Integrates a VLM-style driving agent with a driving world model in an iterative imagination-and-refinement loop.
entries.citation: ImagiDrive — "ImagiDrive: A Unified Imagination-and-Planning Framework for Autonomous Driving." arXiv 2508.11428 (2025).

entries.name: Dream4Drive
entries.fullTitle: Rethinking Driving World Model as Synthetic Data Generator for Perception Tasks
entries.citation: Dream4Drive — "Rethinking Driving World Model as Synthetic Data Generator for Perception Tasks." arXiv 2510.19195 (2025).

entries.name: ProDrive
entries.fullTitle: ProDrive: Proactive Planning for Autonomous Driving via Ego-Environment Co-Evolution
entries.description: A recent planning-oriented paper where the planner and BEV world model are optimized jointly for proactive evaluation of candidate futures.
entries.citation: ProDrive — "ProDrive: Proactive Planning for Autonomous Driving via Ego-Environment Co-Evolution." arXiv 2604.25329 (2026).

entries.name: Grounded World Model for Semantically Generalizable Planning
entries.fullTitle: Grounded World Model for Semantically Generalizable Planning
entries.citation: Grounded World Model for Semantically Generalizable Planning — arXiv 2604.11751 (2026).

entries.name: DINO-WM
entries.fullTitle: DINO-WM: World Models on Pre-trained Visual Features enable Zero-shot Planning
entries.description: A strong representation-first planning result showing that good pretrained visual features can substantially simplify world-model learning.
entries.citation: DINO-WM — "DINO-WM: World Models on Pre-trained Visual Features enable Zero-shot Planning." arXiv 2411.04983 (2024).

entries.name: IMWM
entries.fullTitle: IMWM: Intuition Models Complement World Models for Latent Planning
entries.description: Pairs a learned latent world model with an intuition model to reduce finite-budget planning failures from raw pixels.
entries.citation: IMWM — "IMWM: Intuition Models Complement World Models for Latent Planning." arXiv 2606.01626 (2026).

entries.name: Dream and Search to Control
entries.fullTitle: Dream and Search to Control: Latent Space Planning for Continuous Control
entries.description: Uses tree-based planning over learned latent dynamics for continuous-action control, bootstrapping policy learning and supporting planning at test time.
entries.citation: Dream and Search to Control — Koul, A. et al. "Dream and Search to Control: Latent Space Planning for Continuous Control." arXiv 2020.

entries.name: DriveFuture
entries.fullTitle: DriveFuture: Future-Aware Latent World Models for Autonomous Driving
entries.description: Conditions driving decisions on compact future-aware latent states instead of dense observation- or occupancy-space rollouts, reducing modeling complexity and error accumulation in planner-coupled world models.
entries.citation: DriveFuture — "DriveFuture: Future-Aware Latent World Models for Autonomous Driving." arXiv 2605.09701 (2026).

entries.name: FOREWARN
entries.fullTitle: From Foresight to Forethought: VLM-In-the-Loop Policy Steering via Latent Alignment
entries.description: Decouples foresight (latent world-model rollouts of candidate action plans) from forethought (VLM reasoning over decoded outcomes), unlocking VLMs as open-vocabulary verifiers for runtime steering of generative robot policies.
entries.citation: FOREWARN — "From Foresight to Forethought: VLM-In-the-Loop Policy Steering via Latent Alignment." arXiv 2502.01828 (2025).

entries.name: World Action Planner
entries.fullTitle: World Action Planner: Generalizable Decision-Making with Action-Conditioned World Models
entries.description: VLM-driven planning system that proposes action plans and iteratively refines them via optimization and search over imagined rollouts of a multi-task pose-image-conditioned world model, outperforming end-to-end VLAs and WAMs on compositional and zero-shot generalization.
entries.citation: World Action Planner — "World Action Planner: Generalizable Decision-Making with Action-Conditioned World Models." arXiv 2607.27599 (2026).

entries.name: SAGE
entries.fullTitle: SAGE: Subgoal-Conditioned Action Generation for Latent World Model Planning
entries.description: Replaces random proposal initialization in latent world-model planning with a goal-conditioned generator that predicts reachable latent subgoals at multiple temporal scales to condition candidate action-sequence generation.
entries.citation: SAGE — "SAGE: Subgoal-Conditioned Action Generation for Latent World Model Planning." arXiv 2607.17973 (2026).

entries.name: Affordance Planning with Real-to-Sim Conversion
entries.fullTitle: Affordance-Based Manipulation Planning with Text Goals and Sim-to-Real Generalisation via Real-to-Sim Image Conversion
entries.description: Plans manipulation by predicting action effects as visual futures and scoring candidate plans by multimodal agreement with run-time text goals, adding real-to-sim image conversion so the visual world model transfers to a physical robot setup.
entries.citation: Affordance Planning with Real-to-Sim Conversion — "Affordance-Based Manipulation Planning with Text Goals and Sim-to-Real Generalisation via Real-to-Sim Image Conversion." arXiv 2607.11004 (2026).

entries.name: RP1 (Reinforced Planning)
entries.fullTitle: Reinforced Planning with Latent World Models
entries.description: Learns the plan-improvement operator itself — a critic that evaluates imagined outcomes and an optimizer that revises multi-step plans — trained fully offline from imagined world-model rollouts rather than hand-designed search.
entries.citation: RP1 (Reinforced Planning) — "Reinforced Planning with Latent World Models." arXiv 2608.18669 (2026).

entries.name: Orbit-Planner
entries.fullTitle: Orbit-Planner: Towards Latent World Models for On-Orbit Obstacle Avoidance of Satellite Agents
entries.description: Two-stage latent world model that rolls out action-conditioned spacecraft dynamics in latent space with a Physics Probe decoding physical state changes, attaining 91.7% closed-loop obstacle-avoidance success in Isaac Sim.
entries.citation: Orbit-Planner — "Orbit-Planner: Towards Latent World Models for On-Orbit Obstacle Avoidance of Satellite Agents." AP-GARSS 2026.

entries.name: ELWM
entries.fullTitle: Energy-Structured Latent World Models with Neural Time Fields for Physically Constistent Open-World Motion Planning
entries.description: Structures latent world-model states to explicitly carry energy and momentum with strictly causal dissipation and control ports, guaranteeing physically consistent predictions for open-world motion planning from RGB-D and inertial histories.
entries.citation: ELWM — "Energy-Structured Latent World Models with Neural Time Fields for Physically Constistent Open-World Motion Planning." arXiv 2608.09876 (2026).

entries.name: hint²
entries.fullTitle: hint²: Hierarchical World Models for Inference-Time Temporal Logic Guidance
entries.description: Guides short-horizon chunked manipulation policies toward satisfying long-horizon linear temporal logic specifications at inference time by deriving complementary guidance objectives from hierarchical world models at two abstraction levels.
entries.citation: hint² — "hint²: Hierarchical World Models for Inference-Time Temporal Logic Guidance." arXiv 2608.13678 (2026).

entries.name: Onto-EV-WM
entries.fullTitle: Ontology-Grounded World Models for Failure Diagnosis and Closed-Loop Repair in Physical AI Systems
entries.description: Layers an ontology-grounded diagnosis and verification-gated correction interface over event-scored world models, recording unmet task predicates and routing failures to available correction mechanisms for closed-loop repair.
entries.citation: Onto-EV-WM — "Ontology-Grounded World Models for Failure Diagnosis and Closed-Loop Repair in Physical AI Systems." arXiv 2608.13901 (2026).

entries.name: Traj-LeWM
entries.fullTitle: Traj-LeWM: Path-Aware World-Model Planning via Latent Trajectory Cost
entries.description: Extends the lightweight LeWM visual world model with a goal-conditioned latent trajectory cost so planning ranks candidate action sequences by the evolution of the whole predicted trajectory rather than predicted endpoint distance alone.
entries.citation: Traj-LeWM — "Traj-LeWM: Path-Aware World-Model Planning via Latent Trajectory Cost." arXiv 2608.14125 (2026).

entries.name: ProWorld
entries.fullTitle: ProWorld: Progress-Aware Hyperbolic World Models for Long-Horizon Visual Goal Reaching
entries.description: Augments JEPA-style world models with a goal-conditioned progress order embedded in hyperbolic space, so long-horizon visual goal-reaching rollouts respect coarse-to-fine progress toward the goal instead of only local transition consistency.
entries.citation: ProWorld — "ProWorld: Progress-Aware Hyperbolic World Models for Long-Horizon Visual Goal Reaching." arXiv 2608.01926 (2026).

entries.name: SR-WM
entries.fullTitle: Beyond Instance Slots: Semantically Rich World Models for Physical Interaction Planning
entries.description: Task-conditioned world model structured around five functional roles — gripper, target, goal, relation, and phase — that checks whether candidate actions produce task-consistent futures while preserving essential relations.
entries.citation: SR-WM — "Beyond Instance Slots: Semantically Rich World Models for Physical Interaction Planning." arXiv 2608.22294 (2026).

entries.name: DA-LeWM
entries.fullTitle: Decision-Metric Alignment in Latent World Models: Diagnostics and Action-Conditioned Objectives for MPC Planning
entries.description: Introduces Plan-Real and CEM-stage Spearman diagnostics for whether latent goal distance ranks action candidates by real task progress, and adds inverse-dynamics and demonstration-conditioned goal-action heads to close the alignment gap.
entries.citation: DA-LeWM — "Decision-Metric Alignment in Latent World Models: Diagnostics and Action-Conditioned Objectives for MPC Planning." arXiv 2608.18746 (2026).

entries.name: Objective-Bottleneck Study
entries.fullTitle: The Objective Is the Bottleneck: Latent World Models Encode What Their Planners Cannot Use
entries.description: Empirical study showing latent world models encode task-relevant information that their planning objectives cannot exploit, locating the planning bottleneck in the objective rather than the learned representation.
entries.citation: Objective-Bottleneck Study — "The Objective Is the Bottleneck: Latent World Models Encode What Their Planners Cannot Use." arXiv 2608.12959 (2026).

entries.name: VERDI
entries.fullTitle: verdi: retrieval is not transfer for continual world model optimization
entries.description: Continual framework for evidence-licensed optimization of foundation world models that treats retrieved strategies as hypotheses requiring target-side experimental validation before they count as transferable knowledge.
entries.citation: VERDI — "verdi: retrieval is not transfer for continual world model optimization." arXiv 2608.09537 (2026).

entries.name: WM-Grounded LLM Marine Planning
entries.fullTitle: World-Model-Grounded LLM Planning for AUV and ASV Navigation Near Offshore Wind Farms
entries.description: Grounds LLM mission planning for 6-DOF AUVs and 3-DOF ASVs in a physics-grounded neural world model with three-phase gradient trajectory optimization and MPC-style closed-loop replanning behind a trust-region guard.
entries.citation: WM-Grounded LLM Marine Planning — "World-Model-Grounded LLM Planning for AUV and ASV Navigation Near Offshore Wind Farms." IROS Workshops 2026.

entries.name: One Model, Two Physical Stories
entries.fullTitle: One Model, Two Physical Stories: Auditing Misalignment in Multi-Modal World Modeling
entries.description: Audits disagreement between generated video, textual physical-state predictions, and analytic dynamics through shared event, magnitude, and timing contracts.
entries.citation: One Model, Two Physical Stories — "One Model, Two Physical Stories: Auditing Misalignment in Multi-Modal World Modeling." arXiv 2609.14833 (2026).

entries.name: IMPLY
entries.fullTitle: IMPLY: Physically Anchored Consistency for World-Model Rollouts
entries.description: Infers physical properties implied by multiple rollouts and anchors consistency to observed calibration interactions, distinguishing coherent predictions from predictions grounded in the correct object.
entries.citation: IMPLY — "IMPLY: Physically Anchored Consistency for World-Model Rollouts." arXiv 2609.12441 (2026).

entries.name: Memory Specificity Audit
entries.fullTitle: Does Video Memory Use What It Retrieves? A Causal Audit of Memory Specificity
entries.description: Substitutes memory contents at read time to distinguish useful episodic retrieval from generic representation support in frozen video world models.
entries.citation: Memory Specificity Audit — "Does Video Memory Use What It Retrieves? A Causal Audit of Memory Specificity." arXiv 2609.12090 (2026).

entries.name: Counterfactual Update Utility
entries.fullTitle: Measuring the Value of World-Model Updates: A Counterfactual Utility Protocol for Continual Adaptation
entries.description: Compares matched update-versus-hold deployment branches to measure the causal policy-return utility of continual world-model updates, including failed updates.
entries.citation: Counterfactual Update Utility — "Measuring the Value of World-Model Updates: A Counterfactual Utility Protocol for Continual Adaptation." arXiv 2609.10954 (2026).

entries.name: Compact Visuotactile World Models
entries.fullTitle: Compact Visuotactile World Models for Lifting: Prediction, Reward Alignment, and Force Constraints
entries.description: Compares imagined policy learning and model-assisted force feedback in simulated lifting, showing that improved tactile prediction does not consistently translate into better force-constrained control.
entries.citation: Compact Visuotactile World Models — "Compact Visuotactile World Models for Lifting: Prediction, Reward Alignment, and Force Constraints." arXiv 2609.09597 (2026).

entries.name: Stage-Wise Planning Reliability
entries.fullTitle: Beyond Task Success: Stage-Wise Reliability of World Model Planning under Sensing Degradation
entries.description: Traces visual and temporal sensing degradations through representation, future prediction, action preference, and physical outcomes in paired planning evaluations.
entries.citation: Stage-Wise Planning Reliability — "Beyond Task Success: Stage-Wise Reliability of World Model Planning under Sensing Degradation." arXiv 2609.07126 (2026).

entries.name: Compute-Value Audit
entries.fullTitle: Sampling headroom is not selection gain: a compute-value audit of test-time scaling for video world models
entries.description: Separates the quality available in a larger rollout pool from the quality a selector can recover, accounting for both generation and verification compute.
entries.citation: Compute-Value Audit — "Sampling headroom is not selection gain: a compute-value audit of test-time scaling for video world models." arXiv 2609.13257 (2026).

entries.name: VeriPhy
entries.fullTitle: VeriPhy: Agentic Physical Reasoning for World Model Evaluation and Refinement
entries.description: Compiles physical claims into typed checks and evidence records, yielding traceable supported, contradicted, or unknown judgments over generated video.
entries.citation: VeriPhy — "VeriPhy: Agentic Physical Reasoning for World Model Evaluation and Refinement." arXiv 2609.03153 (2026).

entries.name: Imagined Rollouts versus Feedback Control
entries.fullTitle: Do Better Imagined Rollouts Mean Better Robot Control? A Controlled Study of World-Model Evaluation Under Feedback
entries.description: Compares open-loop and feedback-aware predictive-model evaluation in mobile-robot tracking, showing that rollout horizon and measurement-update schedules jointly affect model rankings.
entries.citation: Imagined Rollouts versus Feedback Control — "Do Better Imagined Rollouts Mean Better Robot Control? A Controlled Study of World-Model Evaluation Under Feedback." arXiv 2609.02811 (2026).

entries.name: Proxy-to-Decision Transfer
entries.fullTitle: From Proxy Learning to Driving Decisions: A Transfer-Based Framework for Evaluating Future-Aware Autonomous Driving Planners
entries.description: Tests whether improvements in future-prediction proxies transfer to reliable driving decisions using paired utility decomposition and robustness gates.
entries.citation: Proxy-to-Decision Transfer — "From Proxy Learning to Driving Decisions: A Transfer-Based Framework for Evaluating Future-Aware Autonomous Driving Planners." arXiv 2609.02688 (2026).

entries.name: Testing Synthetic-Data Utility
entries.fullTitle: Should I Use This Synthetic Dataset for Training? How to Test with Minimal Real Data
entries.description: Develops sequential paired-loss tests for deciding whether simulator-generated data improves performance on real data, with explicit error control and limited evaluation samples.
entries.citation: Testing Synthetic-Data Utility — "Should I Use This Synthetic Dataset for Training? How to Test with Minimal Real Data." arXiv 2608.27996 (2026).

entries.name: Canonical Polynomial Invariant Diagnostics
entries.fullTitle: Diagnosing Faults in Reinforcement Learning Simulators and World Models with Canonical Polynomial Invariants
entries.description: Uses canonical polynomial invariants to localize broken physical constraints and attribute simulator or world-model faults to their underlying parameters.
entries.citation: Canonical Polynomial Invariant Diagnostics — "Diagnosing Faults in Reinforcement Learning Simulators and World Models with Canonical Polynomial Invariants." arXiv 2609.13194 (2026).

entries.name: Cosmos-Surg-dVRK
entries.fullTitle: Cosmos-Surg-dVRK: World Foundation Model-based Automated Online Evaluation of Surgical Robot Policy Learning
entries.description: Fine-tunes Cosmos for surgical rollouts and combines it with video-based scoring to evaluate robot policies against real outcomes.
entries.citation: Cosmos-Surg-dVRK — "Cosmos-Surg-dVRK: World Foundation Model-based Automated Online Evaluation of Surgical Robot Policy Learning." arXiv 2510.16240 (2025).

entries.name: Learning to Drive from a World Model
entries.fullTitle: Learning to Drive from a World Model
entries.description: Trains end-to-end driving policies in on-policy reprojective and learned world-model simulators from real driving data.
entries.citation: Learning to Drive from a World Model — arXiv 2504.19077 (2025).

entries.name: End-to-End Driving with Online Trajectory Evaluation via BEV World Model
entries.fullTitle: End-to-End Driving with Online Trajectory Evaluation via BEV World Model
entries.description: Predicts future BEV states under candidate driving trajectories to support efficient online trajectory evaluation.
entries.citation: End-to-End Driving with Online Trajectory Evaluation via BEV World Model — arXiv 2504.01941 (2025).

entries.name: Mitigating Covariate Shift in Imitation Learning for Autonomous Vehicles Using Latent Space Generative World Models
entries.fullTitle: Mitigating Covariate Shift in Imitation Learning for Autonomous Vehicles Using Latent Space Generative World Models
entries.description: Uses latent action-conditioned dynamics during imitation learning to train recovery from off-distribution driving states.
entries.citation: Mitigating Covariate Shift in Imitation Learning for Autonomous Vehicles Using Latent Space Generative World Models — arXiv 2409.16663 (2024).

entries.name: CarDreamer
entries.fullTitle: CarDreamer: Open-Source Learning Platform for World Model based Autonomous Driving
entries.description: Provides modular world-model backbones, configurable CARLA tasks, and tools for training and evaluating driving agents.
entries.citation: CarDreamer — "CarDreamer: Open-Source Learning Platform for World Model based Autonomous Driving." arXiv 2405.09111 (2024).

entries.name: WorldGym
entries.fullTitle: WorldGym: World Model as An Environment for Policy Evaluation
entries.description: Uses an action-conditioned world model as an evaluation environment for real-robot policies.
entries.citation: WorldGym — "WorldGym: World Model as An Environment for Policy Evaluation." arXiv 2506.00613 (2025).

entries.name: WorldEval
entries.fullTitle: WorldEval: World Model as Real-World Robot Policies Evaluator
entries.description: Evaluates real-robot policies through a learned world model rather than only offline prediction metrics.
entries.citation: WorldEval — "WorldEval: World Model as Real-World Robot Policies Evaluator." arXiv 2505.19017 (2025).

entries.name: RoboWorld
entries.fullTitle: RoboWorld: Fast and Reliable Neural Simulators for Generalist Robot Policy Evaluation
entries.description: Combines a fast autoregressive video world model with task-progress-aware VLM scoring, targeting reliable long-horizon evaluation of generalist robot policies.
entries.citation: RoboWorld — "RoboWorld: Fast and Reliable Neural Simulators for Generalist Robot Policy Evaluation." arXiv 2607.01060 (2026).

entries.name: GigaWorld-1 / WMBench
entries.fullTitle: GigaWorld-1: A Roadmap to Build World Models for Robot Policy Evaluation
entries.description: Studies evaluator-focused world-model design with WMBench, emphasizing long-horizon action fidelity and alignment between simulated and real policy outcomes.
entries.citation: GigaWorld-1 / WMBench — "GigaWorld-1: A Roadmap to Build World Models for Robot Policy Evaluation." arXiv 2607.02642 (2026).

entries.name: GE-Sim 2.0
entries.fullTitle: GE-Sim 2.0: A Roadmap Towards Comprehensive Closed-loop Video World Simulators for Robotic Manipulation
entries.description: Upgrades action-conditioned robot video simulation with proprioceptive state decoding, rollout scoring, and fast policy-in-the-loop evaluation.
entries.citation: GE-Sim 2.0 — "GE-Sim 2.0: A Roadmap Towards Comprehensive Closed-loop Video World Simulators for Robotic Manipulation." arXiv 2605.27491 (2026).

entries.name: PiL-World
entries.fullTitle: PiL-World: A Chunk-Wise World Model for VLA Policy-in-the-Loop Evaluation
entries.description: Moves VLA evaluation from open-loop trajectory replay to chunk-wise policy-in-the-loop world-model rollouts.
entries.citation: PiL-World — "PiL-World: A Chunk-Wise World Model for VLA Policy-in-the-Loop Evaluation." arXiv 2606.05773 (2026).

entries.name: SC3-Eval
entries.fullTitle: SC3-Eval: Evaluating Robot Foundation Models via Self-Consistent Video Generation
entries.description: Adapts action-conditioned video world models into robot policy evaluators using forward-inverse, cross-view, and test-time consistency checks.
entries.citation: SC3-Eval — "SC3-Eval: Evaluating Robot Foundation Models via Self-Consistent Video Generation." arXiv 2606.18610 (2026).

entries.name: WorldMark
entries.fullTitle: WorldMark: A Unified Benchmark Suite for Interactive Video World Models
entries.description: New benchmark suite targeting interactive video world models rather than passive generation only.
entries.citation: WorldMark — "WorldMark: A Unified Benchmark Suite for Interactive Video World Models." arXiv 2604.21686 (2026).

entries.name: RoboWM-Bench
entries.fullTitle: RoboWM-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating World Models in Robotic Manipulation
entries.description: Fills a real gap in manipulation-oriented world-model evaluation.
entries.citation: RoboWM-Bench — "RoboWM-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating World Models in Robotic Manipulation." arXiv 2604.19092 (2026).

entries.name: MiraBench
entries.fullTitle: MiraBench: Evaluating Action-Conditioned Reliability in Robotic World Models
entries.description: Shifts robotic world-model evaluation from visual fidelity toward physics adherence, action fidelity, and optimism-bias detection.
entries.citation: MiraBench — "MiraBench: Evaluating Action-Conditioned Reliability in Robotic World Models." arXiv 2605.29360 (2026).

entries.name: RoboTrustBench
entries.fullTitle: RoboTrustBench: Benchmarking the Trustworthiness of Video World Models for Robotic Manipulation
entries.description: Tests whether video world models respect constraints, counterfactual states, physical interactions, and unsafe-instruction rejection.
entries.citation: RoboTrustBench — "RoboTrustBench: Benchmarking the Trustworthiness of Video World Models for Robotic Manipulation." arXiv 2606.01600 (2026).

entries.name: What-If World
entries.fullTitle: What-If World: A Causal Benchmark for General World Models in Embodied Scenarios
entries.description: Evaluates counterfactual, intervention-aware prediction in embodied world models rather than only next-frame realism.
entries.citation: What-If World — "What-If World: A Causal Benchmark for General World Models in Embodied Scenarios." arXiv 2605.27589 (2026).

entries.name: Beyond Task Success
entries.fullTitle: Beyond Task Success: Behavioral and Representational Diagnostics for WAM and VLA
entries.description: Diagnoses whether future-prediction WAMs capture behaviorally meaningful consequences, not just visually plausible rollouts.
entries.citation: Beyond Task Success — "Beyond Task Success: Behavioral and Representational Diagnostics for WAM and VLA." arXiv 2606.01095 (2026).

entries.name: dWorldEval
entries.fullTitle: dWorldEval: Scalable Robotic Policy Evaluation via Discrete Diffusion World Model
entries.citation: dWorldEval — "dWorldEval: Scalable Robotic Policy Evaluation via Discrete Diffusion World Model." arXiv 2604.22152 (2026).

entries.name: Interactive World Simulator
entries.fullTitle: Interactive World Simulator for Robot Policy Training and Evaluation
entries.description: Builds a faster, more physically consistent interactive simulator for robot policy training and evaluation from moderate-scale real interaction data.
entries.citation: Interactive World Simulator — "Interactive World Simulator for Robot Policy Training and Evaluation." arXiv 2603.08546 (2026).

entries.name: Ego-Centric Learning of Communicative World Models
entries.fullTitle: Ego-centric Learning of Communicative World Models for Autonomous Driving
entries.citation: Ego-Centric Learning of Communicative World Models — arXiv 2506.08149 (2025).

entries.name: Reference-Free Physical Consistency
entries.fullTitle: Reference-Free Assessment of Physical Consistency in World Model-based Video Generation
entries.description: Introduces reference-free diagnostics for physical consistency in generated rollouts, useful when ground-truth future videos are unavailable.
entries.citation: Reference-Free Physical Consistency — "Reference-Free Assessment of Physical Consistency in World Model-based Video Generation." arXiv 2606.22363 (2026).

entries.name: Validate the Dream
entries.fullTitle: Validate the Dream Before You Trust Its Verdict: Admissibility for World-Model Simulators
entries.description: Treats admissibility and pre-use certification as prerequisites before trusting a world-model simulator for policy or safety verdicts.
entries.citation: Validate the Dream — "Validate the Dream Before You Trust Its Verdict: Admissibility for World-Model Simulators." arXiv 2607.07196 (2026).

entries.name: WorldSimProbe
entries.fullTitle: WorldSimProbe: Diagnosing Simulator Faithfulness in Action-Conditioned World Models for Embodied Manipulation
entries.description: Formalizes an "Observable Simulator Contract" (actions must induce agent motion; environment responses must be grounded in that motion) and probes it with five controlled suites over 18,000+ instances across RoboTwin, ManiSkill, and LIBERO.
entries.citation: WorldSimProbe — "WorldSimProbe: Diagnosing Simulator Faithfulness in Action-Conditioned World Models for Embodied Manipulation." arXiv 2608.09298 (2026).

entries.name: WorldCycle
entries.fullTitle: WorldCycle: Self-Verifiable Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Video World Models
entries.description: Turns reversible action cycles into annotation-free verification: a sequence composed with its inverse must return to the initial state, yielding spatial-closure and temporal-consistency rewards (plus the CycleBench diagnostic) that cut state-returning drift by up to 44%.
entries.citation: WorldCycle — "WorldCycle: Self-Verifiable Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Video World Models." arXiv 2608.04964 (2026).

entries.name: SIMPLER
entries.fullTitle: Evaluating Real-World Robot Manipulation Policies in Simulation
entries.description: The de-facto standard simulated evaluation suite for real-robot manipulation policies, mitigating control and visual real-to-sim disparities and demonstrating strong correlation between simulated and real-world policy performance.
entries.citation: SIMPLER — "Evaluating Real-World Robot Manipulation Policies in Simulation." CoRL 2024.

entries.name: KineBench
entries.fullTitle: KineBench: Benchmarking Embodied World Models via IDM-Free Kinematic Grounding
entries.description: IDM-free closed-loop benchmark that grounds world-model-generated videos kinematically with cascaded visual foundation models, removing the attribution ambiguity introduced by brittle learned inverse-dynamics action extractors.
entries.citation: KineBench — "KineBench: Benchmarking Embodied World Models via IDM-Free Kinematic Grounding." ECCV 2026.

entries.name: XEWorld
entries.fullTitle: XEWorld: Can Action-Conditioned World Models Generalize to Unseen Robot Embodiments?
entries.description: Controlled cross-embodiment testbed that evaluates action-conditioned world models on held-out robots in physically identical scenes, finding current models behave as 2D visual pattern matchers governed by visual rather than kinematic similarity.
entries.citation: XEWorld — "XEWorld: Can Action-Conditioned World Models Generalize to Unseen Robot Embodiments?" arXiv 2608.05799 (2026).

entries.name: SurgWMBench
entries.fullTitle: SurgWMBench: A Vision-Based Benchmark for World-Modeling Surgical Instrument Motion Planning
entries.description: Benchmark evaluating whether surgical world models jointly capture future video state transitions and instrument motion dynamics, moving beyond FVD-style generation metrics that are poorly aligned with instrument motion.
entries.citation: SurgWMBench — "SurgWMBench: A Vision-Based Benchmark for World-Modeling Surgical Instrument Motion Planning." arXiv 2608.08070 (2026).

entries.name: H2R-Bench
entries.fullTitle: H2R-Bench: Benchmarking Human-to-Robot Manipulation Video Generation in World Models
entries.description: Benchmark for cross-embodiment human-to-robot video generation in which world models must transform egocentric human demonstrations into robot manipulation videos under specified target embodiments.
entries.citation: H2R-Bench — "H2R-Bench: Benchmarking Human-to-Robot Manipulation Video Generation in World Models." arXiv 2608.13049 (2026).

entries.name: CG-World
entries.fullTitle: CG-World: A Large-Scale World-State Dataset and Protocol for World Models
entries.description: ~850K temporally aligned segments from industrial CG production pipelines with explicit latent states, events, physics caches, and branch lineages, supporting intervention learning and counterfactual evaluation of world models.
entries.citation: CG-World — "CG-World: A Large-Scale World-State Dataset and Protocol for World Models." arXiv 2607.26452 (2026).

entries.name: BWM
entries.fullTitle: BWM: A Low-Cost High-Fidelity World Simulator for Robot Learning
entries.description: Open-source action-conditioned world simulator combining initial-environment guidance, dynamic visual history, and temporally aligned robot-action conditioning for stateful autoregressive prediction of action consequences before physical execution.
entries.citation: BWM — "BWM: A Low-Cost High-Fidelity World Simulator for Robot Learning." arXiv 2607.29302 (2026).

entries.name: CaliBench
entries.fullTitle: CaliBench: Are the Stochastic Dynamics of Video World Models Physically Calibrated?
entries.description: Tests aleatoric calibration of video world models by scoring generations in discrete outcome spaces with closed-form reference distributions (Galton boards, dice, roulette), decomposing performance into scorability and calibration.
entries.citation: CaliBench — "CaliBench: Are the Stochastic Dynamics of Video World Models Physically Calibrated?" arXiv 2608.16829 (2026).

entries.name: GAUGE
entries.fullTitle: GAUGE: A Measurement-Grounded Benchmark for Physical Fidelity in Simulation Engines and Video World Models
entries.description: Diagnostic benchmark of 22 controlled task families over rigid bodies, cables, textiles, and volumetric deformables, grounded in real-world trajectories with calibrated metadata, that jointly evaluates physics engines and generative video world models.
entries.citation: GAUGE — "GAUGE: A Measurement-Grounded Benchmark for Physical Fidelity in Simulation Engines and Video World Models." arXiv 2608.05948 (2026).

entries.name: VIScore
entries.fullTitle: VIScore: Diagnosing Planning-Relevant Quality in Latent World Models
entries.description: Diagnoses which latent-space properties actually correlate with planning success, showing flexible VISReg isotropic regularization improves out-of-domain planning where the SSL-standard SIGReg does not.
entries.citation: VIScore — "VIScore: Diagnosing Planning-Relevant Quality in Latent World Models." arXiv 2608.11174 (2026).

entries.name: Where World Models Break
entries.fullTitle: Where World Models Break: Natural-Input Failure Discovery
entries.description: Formalizes natural-input failure discovery for action-conditioned world models: under a finite query budget, finding environment-valid conditions and action prefixes that induce severe, seed-reproducible prediction failures.
entries.citation: Where World Models Break — "Where World Models Break: Natural-Input Failure Discovery." arXiv 2608.22421 (2026).

entries.name: Paired Exact-Reset Evaluation
entries.fullTitle: Paired Exact-Reset Evaluation of a Prediction-Derived Medium-to-Full World-Model Cascade
entries.description: Paired exact-reset audit protocol on a 1,600-state PushT bank that executes all candidate actions from identical reset states, defining when routing from a Medium to a frozen Full world-model predictor justifies its sequential overhead.
entries.citation: Paired Exact-Reset Evaluation — "Paired Exact-Reset Evaluation of a Prediction-Derived Medium-to-Full World-Model Cascade." arXiv 2608.14650 (2026).

entries.name: HORIZON
entries.fullTitle: Hierarchical Belief Modeling for Zero-Shot Opponent Adaptation in Partially Observable Multi-Agent Navigation
entries.description: Combines hierarchical belief and opponent modeling with action-conditioned next-state raster prediction as auxiliary supervision for adaptive multi-agent policies in partially observed Lux AI games.
entries.citation: HORIZON — "Hierarchical Belief Modeling for Zero-Shot Opponent Adaptation in Partially Observable Multi-Agent Navigation." arXiv 2609.12422 (2026).

entries.name: Hi-FLoop
entries.fullTitle: Hi-FLoop: Hierarchical State-Feedback Loops for Multi-Timescale World Modeling
entries.description: Maintains a shared joint-world branch across agents while updating goal, interaction, and control states at different timescales for coherent closed-loop traffic simulation.
entries.citation: Hi-FLoop — "Hi-FLoop: Hierarchical State-Feedback Loops for Multi-Timescale World Modeling." arXiv 2609.08796 (2026).

entries.name: PV-WM
entries.fullTitle: PV-WM: A Heterogeneous Micro-Macro World Model for Articulated Pedestrian-Vehicle Co-Rollout
entries.description: Recurrently co-predicts pedestrian root motion and articulation together with vehicle kinematic states, recomputing cross-agent geometry from generated states at each transition.
entries.citation: PV-WM — "PV-WM: A Heterogeneous Micro-Macro World Model for Articulated Pedestrian-Vehicle Co-Rollout." arXiv 2609.07328 (2026).

entries.name: RMWorld
entries.fullTitle: RMWorld: Task-Aware Radio World Models with Value-of-Information Guided Multi-Trial Learning for Multi-UAV Communication Control
entries.description: Combines task-aware Bayesian radio-dynamics calibration with credibility- and diversity-based counterfactual branch selection for multi-UAV communication control.
entries.citation: RMWorld — "RMWorld: Task-Aware Radio World Models with Value-of-Information Guided Multi-Trial Learning for Multi-UAV Communication Control." arXiv 2608.20126 (2026).

entries.name: Logic-Guided Socially-aware Robot Navigation World Model
entries.fullTitle: Logic-Guided Socially-aware Robot Navigation World Model
entries.description: Combines structured spatiotemporal state and logic-guided reasoning for socially constrained robot navigation.
entries.citation: Logic-Guided Socially-aware Robot Navigation World Model — arXiv 2510.23509 (2025).

entries.name: Social World Model-Augmented Mechanism Design Policy Learning
entries.fullTitle: Social World Model-Augmented Mechanism Design Policy Learning
entries.description: Infers persistent agent traits and simulates responses to mechanisms to train sample-efficient social policies.
entries.citation: Social World Model-Augmented Mechanism Design Policy Learning — arXiv 2510.19270 (2025).

entries.name: Empowering Multi-Robot Cooperation via Sequential World Models
entries.fullTitle: Empowering Multi-Robot Cooperation via Sequential World Models
entries.description: Autoregressively factorizes multi-robot dynamics by agent to share predicted intentions and plan cooperative actions.
entries.citation: Empowering Multi-Robot Cooperation via Sequential World Models — arXiv 2509.13095 (2025).

entries.name: Social World Models
entries.fullTitle: Social World Models
entries.description: Represents evolving social states, beliefs, and intentions to predict interlocutors' future actions and mental states.
entries.citation: Social World Models — arXiv 2509.00559 (2025).

entries.name: SocioVerse
entries.fullTitle: SocioVerse: A World Model for Social Simulation Powered by LLM Agents and A Pool of 10 Million Real-World Users
entries.description: Simulates population-level social dynamics with language-model agents and aligned user, interaction, and environment representations.
entries.citation: SocioVerse — "SocioVerse: A World Model for Social Simulation Powered by LLM Agents and A Pool of 10 Million Real-World Users." arXiv 2504.10157 (2025).

entries.name: Perspective-Shifted Neuro-Symbolic World Models
entries.fullTitle: Perspective-Shifted Neuro-Symbolic World Models: A Framework for Socially-Aware Robot Navigation
entries.description: Combines neuro-symbolic dynamics and perspective-shifted belief estimation for social navigation under partial observability.
entries.citation: Perspective-Shifted Neuro-Symbolic World Models — "Perspective-Shifted Neuro-Symbolic World Models: A Framework for Socially-Aware Robot Navigation." arXiv 2503.20425 (2025).

entries.name: Grounded Answers for Multi-agent Decision-making Problem through Generative World Model
entries.fullTitle: Grounded Answers for Multi-agent Decision-making Problem through Generative World Model
entries.description: Combines language-guided reward modeling and visual transition simulation to train multi-agent policies and generate grounded interaction sequences.
entries.citation: Grounded Answers for Multi-agent Decision-making Problem through Generative World Model — arXiv 2410.02664 (2024).

entries.name: COMBO
entries.fullTitle: COMBO: Compositional World Models for Embodied Multi-Agent Cooperation
entries.description: Composes multiple agents' action-conditioned visual futures and uses tree search for cooperative planning under partial observability.
entries.citation: COMBO — "COMBO: Compositional World Models for Embodied Multi-Agent Cooperation." arXiv 2404.10775 (2024).

entries.name: Implicit Causal World Models
entries.fullTitle: Learning Implicit Causal World Models from Multi-Agent Demonstrations
entries.description: Recovers environment dynamics from offline multi-agent demonstrations without predefined causal graphs. Policy variation supplies sequential-backdoor identification signals that separate environmental mechanisms from strategic agent intent.
entries.citation: Implicit Causal World Models — Ghosh, J. "Learning Implicit Causal World Models from Multi-Agent Demonstrations." arXiv 2607.26336 (2026).

entries.name: Dreamer-CPC
entries.fullTitle: Dreamer-CPC: Message Learning with World Models for Decentralized Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning
entries.description: Integrates Collective Predictive Coding into decentralized DreamerV3 world models. Each agent communicates messages inferred from latent states that summarize past observations and actions, improving coordination under partial observability.
entries.citation: Dreamer-CPC — Takayama, T., Yoshida, N. & Taniguchi, T. "Dreamer-CPC: Message Learning with World Models for Decentralized Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning." arXiv 2607.19809 (2026).

entries.name: MultiWorld
entries.fullTitle: MultiWorld: Scalable Multi-Agent Multi-View Video World Models
entries.description: Unified framework for multi-agent, multi-view world modeling; introduces a Multi-Agent Condition Module and Global State Encoder for precise controllability and cross-view consistency.
entries.citation: MultiWorld — Wu, H. et al. "MultiWorld: Scalable Multi-Agent Multi-View Video World Models." arXiv 2604.18564 (2026).

entries.name: MetaWorld
entries.fullTitle: MetaWorld: Scaling Multi-Agent Video World Model from Single-view Video Data
entries.description: Extracts shared multi-agent world-state signals from ordinary single-view video, improving cross-view identity and dynamics consistency without dense multi-camera data.
entries.citation: MetaWorld — "MetaWorld: Scaling Multi-Agent Video World Model from Single-view Video Data." arXiv 2606.02753 (2026).

entries.name: Prisma-World
entries.fullTitle: Prisma-World: Camera-Controllable Multi-Agent Video World Model
entries.description: Jointly denoises multiple camera-controlled agent views with geometry-aware attention and a dedicated PrismaDataset for consistency training.
entries.citation: Prisma-World — "Prisma-World: Camera-Controllable Multi-Agent Video World Model." arXiv 2606.09507 (2026).

entries.name: ShareVerse
entries.fullTitle: ShareVerse: Multi-Agent Consistent Video Generation for Shared World Modeling
entries.description: Explicitly targets a shared multi-agent world state across viewpoints, filling a gap between single-user interaction and jointly consistent world generation.
entries.citation: ShareVerse — "ShareVerse: Multi-Agent Consistent Video Generation for Shared World Modeling." arXiv 2603.02697 (2026).

entries.name: SceneDiffuser++
entries.fullTitle: SceneDiffuser++: City-Scale Traffic Simulation via a Generative World Model
entries.citation: SceneDiffuser++ — (see §1.2.4) City-scale traffic simulation with multi-agent world model.

entries.name: EOT-WM
entries.fullTitle: Other Vehicle Trajectories Are Also Needed: A Driving World Model Unifies Ego-Other Vehicle Trajectories in Video Latent Space
entries.citation: EOT-WM — (see §1.2.2) Jointly models ego and other vehicle trajectories.

entries.name: InDRiVE
entries.fullTitle: InDRiVE: Intrinsic Disagreement based Reinforcement for Vehicle Exploration through Curiosity Driven Generalized World Model
entries.description: Curiosity-driven generalized WM
entries.citation: InDRiVE — (see §3.1) Curiosity-driven exploration in multi-agent driving world model.

entries.name: Communicative World Models
entries.fullTitle: Ego-centric Learning of Communicative World Models for Autonomous Driving
entries.citation: Communicative World Models — (see §3.3) Ego-centric communicative modeling of other agents.

entries.name: MASS
entries.fullTitle: MASS: Multiplayer World Models with Authoritative Shared State
entries.description: Borrows multiplayer-game architecture: a learned Logic Engine advances a single authoritative typed world state from joint actions, while a Rendering Engine decodes consistent per-camera views — scaling to 1,024 concurrent players over 10,000 recurrent steps.
entries.citation: MASS — "MASS: Multiplayer World Models with Authoritative Shared State." arXiv 2608.06257 (2026).

entries.name: Khora
entries.fullTitle: Population-Scalable Multi-Agent World Modeling
entries.description: Decouples shared world-state evolution from view-conditioned rendering with a population-agnostic rendering interface, enabling inference-time expansion to arbitrary agent counts without retraining and near-linear scaling in queried views.
entries.citation: Khora — "Population-Scalable Multi-Agent World Modeling." arXiv 2608.08600 (2026).

entries.name: When the World Lies
entries.fullTitle: When the World Lies: Backdoor Attacks on Latent World Models for Downstream Control
entries.description: Studies checkpoint backdoors that reshape latent dynamics and redirect downstream imagination-trained policies or planners while preserving useful clean-task behavior.
entries.citation: When the World Lies — "When the World Lies: Backdoor Attacks on Latent World Models for Downstream Control." arXiv 2609.15781 (2026).

entries.name: Legislating World-Model-Based Planning
entries.fullTitle: Legislating World-Model-Based Planning with Legal Reasoning
entries.description: Couples defeasible deontic reasoning to learned-world-model motion planning and measures how perception errors and alternative legal-to-metric translations affect simulated robot compliance.
entries.citation: Legislating World-Model-Based Planning — "Legislating World-Model-Based Planning with Legal Reasoning." arXiv 2609.15113 (2026).

entries.name: FARM
entries.fullTitle: FARM: Reading Failure Signals from the Internal Predictive States of a Frozen Robotic World Model
entries.description: Reads stepwise failure risk from frozen VLA-JEPA predictive states with a lightweight supervised head, testing transfer and readout-only adaptation across real robot populations.
entries.citation: FARM — "FARM: Reading Failure Signals from the Internal Predictive States of a Frozen Robotic World Model." arXiv 2609.11445 (2026).

entries.name: TrojanWorld
entries.fullTitle: TrojanWorld: Backdooring World-Model Agents via Imagination Steering
entries.description: Evaluates physical-trigger backdoors that steer world-model imagination and downstream behavior, including persistence after trigger removal across several model-based RL systems.
entries.citation: TrojanWorld — "TrojanWorld: Backdooring World-Model Agents via Imagination Steering." arXiv 2609.07051 (2026).

entries.name: WHIRL
entries.fullTitle: How to Learn from What a Human Would Avoid? Intervention-Aware World Models with Real-World RL for Dexterous Manipulation
entries.description: Predicts future human-intervention probability alongside latent dynamics, rewards, and termination, using takeover risk to shape real-world dexterous-manipulation policy learning.
entries.citation: WHIRL — "How to Learn from What a Human Would Avoid? Intervention-Aware World Models with Real-World RL for Dexterous Manipulation." arXiv 2609.06009 (2026).

entries.name: SAGE
entries.fullTitle: Self-Aware Active Learning Enables Continual Improvement in Autonomous Driving
entries.description: Combines predictive risk and novelty signals from a world model to schedule expert takeovers and focus post-training adaptation on unfamiliar, safety-critical driving situations.
entries.citation: SAGE — "Self-Aware Active Learning Enables Continual Improvement in Autonomous Driving." arXiv 2608.29772 (2026).

entries.name: Certified Code Worlds and Reachability
entries.fullTitle: An Enclosed Mode Is a Gauge Choice: Topology Relative to Reach in Certified Code World Models
entries.description: Studies when unreachable topology errors evade world-model certification and when planners can exploit them, testing reachability-dependent diagnostics and dimension-matched mitigations.
entries.citation: Certified Code Worlds and Reachability — "An Enclosed Mode Is a Gauge Choice: Topology Relative to Reach in Certified Code World Models." arXiv 2608.28541 (2026).

entries.name: DreamLedger
entries.fullTitle: DreamLedger: Where to Refuse World-Model Imagination Using Execution-Settled Credit
entries.description: Records consumed predictions, checks them against execution, and uses accumulated evidence to decide when to refuse further imagination in comparable operating conditions.
entries.citation: DreamLedger — "DreamLedger: Where to Refuse World-Model Imagination Using Execution-Settled Credit." arXiv 2608.23863 (2026).

entries.name: CIVA
entries.fullTitle: CIVA: Critic-Induced Value-Subspace Attacks on Visual World-Model Agents
entries.description: Studies critic-induced low-dimensional perturbations against visual world-model agents, measuring their effects on recurrent dynamics, reward, and temporal consistency under bounded observation attacks.
entries.citation: CIVA — "CIVA: Critic-Induced Value-Subspace Attacks on Visual World-Model Agents." arXiv 2608.21114 (2026).

entries.name: RiskWorld
entries.fullTitle: RiskWorld: Object-Centric Latent World Modeling for Autonomous Driving Risk Identification
entries.description: Rolls object-centric ego-relative states forward with RSSM-style dynamics to identify emerging risk sources and preserve planning-critical objects in driving observations.
entries.citation: RiskWorld — "RiskWorld: Object-Centric Latent World Modeling for Autonomous Driving Risk Identification." arXiv 2608.21414 (2026).

entries.name: WM-RMoE
entries.fullTitle: Risk-Aware Decision-Making for Autonomous Overtaking: A World Model-Based Mixture-of-Experts Framework
entries.description: Uses latent multi-step rollouts to assess cumulative overtaking risk and coordinate long-horizon, short-horizon, and rule-based safety experts while retaining multimodal maneuvers.
entries.citation: WM-RMoE — "Risk-Aware Decision-Making for Autonomous Overtaking: A World Model-Based Mixture-of-Experts Framework." arXiv 2609.00385 (2026).

entries.name: How Well Do Latent World Models Understand Partially Observable Safety Constraints?
entries.fullTitle: How Well Do Latent World Models Understand Partially Observable Safety Constraints?
entries.description: Diagnoses missing safety information in latent states and rollouts, and studies multimodal supervision and risk calibration.
entries.citation: How Well Do Latent World Models Understand Partially Observable Safety Constraints? — arXiv 2510.06492 (2025).

entries.name: PIGDreamer
entries.fullTitle: PIGDreamer: Privileged Information Guided World Models for Safe Partially Observable Reinforcement Learning
entries.description: Uses privileged state information during training to guide latent dynamics and safe policies under partial observability.
entries.citation: PIGDreamer — "PIGDreamer: Privileged Information Guided World Models for Safe Partially Observable Reinforcement Learning." arXiv 2508.02159 (2025).

entries.name: World Model-Based End-to-End Scene Generation for Accident Anticipation in Autonomous Driving
entries.fullTitle: World Model-Based End-to-End Scene Generation for Accident Anticipation in Autonomous Driving
entries.description: Generates rare driving scenarios and combines them with temporal graph reasoning to study accident anticipation.
entries.citation: World Model-Based End-to-End Scene Generation for Accident Anticipation in Autonomous Driving — arXiv 2507.12762 (2025).

entries.name: Policy-Driven World Model Adaptation for Robust Offline Model-based Reinforcement Learning
entries.fullTitle: Policy-Driven World Model Adaptation for Robust Offline Model-based Reinforcement Learning
entries.description: Adapts offline dynamics and policies jointly through a maximin objective to improve robustness under noisy deployment conditions.
entries.citation: Policy-Driven World Model Adaptation for Robust Offline Model-based Reinforcement Learning — arXiv 2505.13709 (2025).

entries.name: Multi-Task Interactive Robot Fleet Learning with Visual World Models
entries.fullTitle: Multi-Task Interactive Robot Fleet Learning with Visual World Models
entries.description: Uses visual action-outcome prediction to anticipate robot anomalies and adapt human-intervention requests during fleet learning.
entries.citation: Multi-Task Interactive Robot Fleet Learning with Visual World Models — arXiv 2410.22689 (2024).

entries.name: UMAD
entries.fullTitle: UMAD: Unsupervised Mask-Level Anomaly Detection for Autonomous Driving
entries.description: Uses generative world-model predictions with unsupervised masks to detect anomalous driving observations without labeled outliers.
entries.citation: UMAD — "UMAD: Unsupervised Mask-Level Anomaly Detection for Autonomous Driving." arXiv 2406.06370 (2024).

entries.name: WAKER
entries.fullTitle: Reward-Free Curricula for Training Robust World Models
entries.description: Selects reward-free exploration environments according to world-model error to improve robust transfer across tasks.
entries.citation: WAKER — "Reward-Free Curricula for Training Robust World Models." arXiv 2306.09205 (2023).

entries.name: VLM-SAFE
entries.fullTitle: VLM-SAFE: Vision-Language Model-Guided Safety-Aware Reinforcement Learning with World Models for Autonomous Driving
entries.description: Language-conditioned safety constraints integrated into world-model-based RL for driving.
entries.citation: VLM-SAFE — "VLM-SAFE: Vision-Language Model-Guided Safety-Aware Reinforcement Learning with World Models for Autonomous Driving." arXiv 2505.16377 (2025).

entries.name: StressDream
entries.fullTitle: StressDream: Steering Video World Models for Robust Policy Evaluation and Improvement
entries.description: Steers diffusion world-model imaginations toward high-impact plausible outcomes, useful for stress-testing policies beyond nominal rollouts.
entries.citation: StressDream — "StressDream: Steering Video World Models for Robust Policy Evaluation and Improvement." arXiv 2606.00267 (2026).

entries.name: BadWorld
entries.fullTitle: BadWorld: Adversarial Attacks on World Models
entries.description: Label-free adversarial attacks expose rollout collapse and control inconsistency in visual world models from tiny context-image perturbations.
entries.citation: BadWorld — "BadWorld: Adversarial Attacks on World Models." arXiv 2606.16519 (2026).

entries.name: World-Model Supply-Chain Poisoning
entries.fullTitle: Targeting World Models to Compromise Robot Learning Pipelines
entries.description: Shows how malicious prompts or transition dynamics can poison synthetic robot data only after passing through a world model, creating stealthy downstream policy backdoors.
entries.citation: World-Model Supply-Chain Poisoning — "Targeting World Models to Compromise Robot Learning Pipelines." arXiv 2606.09499 (2026).

entries.name: Foresight
entries.fullTitle: Foresight: Failure Detection for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation with Action-Conditioned World Model Latents
entries.description: Uses predictive world-model embeddings and conformal calibration to detect long-horizon manipulation failures across policies, simulation suites, and real robots.
entries.citation: Foresight — "Foresight: Failure Detection for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation with Action-Conditioned World Model Latents." arXiv 2606.23085 (2026).

entries.name: Trusted Imagination Attacks
entries.fullTitle: Attacking the Trusted Imagination: Oracle-Level Integrity Attacks on Imagine-then-Act World Models
entries.description: Identifies the imagined latent future in WAM-style policies as an attack surface for MPC, safety gates, and imagine-then-check verifiers.
entries.citation: Trusted Imagination Attacks — "Attacking the Trusted Imagination: Oracle-Level Integrity Attacks on Imagine-then-Act World Models." arXiv 2606.22966 (2026).

entries.name: World Models in Pieces
entries.fullTitle: World Models in Pieces: Structural Certification for General Agents
entries.description: Formalizes transition-local certification for agent world models, helping identify where long-horizon planning is structurally reliable rather than relying on worst-case guarantees.
entries.citation: World Models in Pieces — "World Models in Pieces: Structural Certification for General Agents." ICML 2026.

entries.name: World Models: The Safety Perspective
entries.fullTitle: World Models: The Safety Perspective
entries.description: Position/survey: how to make world models safer across embodied AI and autonomous driving.
entries.citation: World Models: The Safety Perspective — ISSREW 2024.

entries.name: The Safety Challenge of World Models for Embodied AI Agents
entries.fullTitle: The Safety Challenge of World Models for Embodied AI Agents: A Review
entries.description: Comprehensive review of safety risks introduced by using world models in agentic embodied systems.
entries.citation: The Safety Challenge of World Models for Embodied AI Agents — arXiv 2510.05865 (2025).

entries.name: Progressive Robustness-Aware World Models
entries.fullTitle: Progressive Robustness-Aware World Models
entries.citation: Progressive Robustness-Aware World Models — techrXiv 2025.

entries.name: BadWAM
entries.fullTitle: BadWAM: When World-Action Models Dream Right but Act Wrong
entries.description: Introduces World-Action Drift Attacks: small visual perturbations that desynchronize what a world-action model imagines from what it executes, including stealthy imagination-preserving variants that defeat imagine-then-check verification.
entries.citation: BadWAM — "BadWAM: When World-Action Models Dream Right but Act Wrong." arXiv 2607.15207 (2026).

entries.name: False Prophets
entries.fullTitle: False Prophets: On the Security of World Models in Agentic Systems
entries.description: Systematizes world-model-specific vulnerabilities in LLM agent pipelines with a security benchmark for text-based world models; induced mispredictions reach 95% success and enable command execution, denial of service, and data extraction.
entries.citation: False Prophets — "False Prophets: On the Security of World Models in Agentic Systems." arXiv 2607.23147 (2026).

entries.name: DreamGuard
entries.fullTitle: DreamGuard: Efficient Runtime Guardrail for LLM Agents via Risk-Aware World Model
entries.description: Proactive guardrail built on a recurrent risk-aware latent world model that forecasts multi-horizon hazard evidence before action execution, achieving the best safety-utility trade-off at ~25 ms per call.
entries.citation: DreamGuard — "DreamGuard: Efficient Runtime Guardrail for LLM Agents via Risk-Aware World Model." arXiv 2608.05695 (2026).

entries.name: VeriScene
entries.fullTitle: VeriScene: Reconstructing Crime Scenes from Legal Evidence via World-Model Agent
entries.description: Orchestrates evidence-grounded scene reconstruction and dynamic probe rollouts, using explicit constraints and audits before rendering a hypothesized physical reenactment.
entries.citation: VeriScene — "VeriScene: Reconstructing Crime Scenes from Legal Evidence via World-Model Agent." arXiv 2609.08342 (2026).

entries.fullTitle: Discriminative World Models for Web Agents
entries.description: Trains web-state predictions to distinguish outcomes of alternative actions, aligning world-model representations with candidate ranking and improving web-agent action selection.
entries.citation: Discriminative World Models — "Discriminative World Models for Web Agents." arXiv 2609.02885 (2026).

entries.citation: Belief-Calibrated Optimization — "Belief-Calibrated Optimization: An Explicit World Model for Agentic Optimization." arXiv 2609.01861 (2026).

entries.description: Learns a user-engagement simulator that predicts counterfactual feedback for candidate recommendations, supplying rewards for downstream policy optimization before user exposure.
entries.citation: WMG-RL — "World Model-Guided Reinforcement Learning via Counterfactual User Engagement Simulation." arXiv 2609.01067 (2026).

entries.fullTitle: Solaris: Towards Interfaces That Are Generated, Not Coded
entries.description: Generates interactive interface frames conditioned on mouse actions, combining causal video generation, few-step distillation, and language-guided intent to model UI appearance and behavior.
entries.citation: Solaris — "Solaris: Towards Interfaces That Are Generated, Not Coded." arXiv 2609.00776 (2026).

entries.fullTitle: Towards a Belief-Based World Model for LLM Agents
entries.description: Exposes world-model beliefs about known and uncertain state directly to LLM policies, testing their decision-making value under partial observability alongside simulated futures.
entries.citation: Belief-Based World Models — "Towards a Belief-Based World Model for LLM Agents." arXiv 2609.00455 (2026).

entries.name: FAIRY
entries.fullTitle: Deploying and Evaluating a Smart-Agriculture Agentic Engine for Full-Season Soybean Farm Operations
entries.description: Uses an event-driven farm process model to couple crop evolution, machinery actions, and management interventions, evaluating agent controllers over complete soybean-production scenarios.
entries.citation: FAIRY — "Deploying and Evaluating a Smart-Agriculture Agentic Engine for Full-Season Soybean Farm Operations." arXiv 2609.00106 (2026).

entries.name: World-Model / Policy Composition
entries.fullTitle: How do World Models and Policies Compose in LLM Agents? A Joint Spectral and Behavioral Account
entries.description: Analyzes how next-state prediction and policy-learning updates compose in LLM agents, using parameter interventions, training-free merging, and auxiliary world-model losses to preserve environment knowledge.
entries.citation: World-Model / Policy Composition — "How do World Models and Policies Compose in LLM Agents? A Joint Spectral and Behavioral Account." arXiv 2608.30067 (2026).
